These are different states: a reader distinguishes them by 入场计划ID (see that field's notes), rendering an explicit neutral 'status unavailable' badge in the second case rather than silently falling back to the legacy 价格位置 badge, which would compete with the plan-based display the acceptance criteria forbid. 暂停复核 reflects the plan's own 失效条件 having been triggered, not an automatic sell signal. A quote below a 下跌复核线 that the plan's own 失效条件/计划复核触发 explicitly states (e.g. 下跌复核线=135 USD, '跌破135复核', or '低于区间下沿暂停复核' meaning the lowest end of all priced zones) is such a trigger, and Daily and Weekly both write 暂停复核 (Issue #306, 2026-10-18: the same ORCL v5 plan and quote gave 等待价格 in Daily and 暂停复核 in Weekly); without a stated line a below-range quote is 等待价格, and no report derives a line from the lowest zone, the anchor or a percentage drop. A '低于X先复核' written in 技术确认条件/订单类型/跳空处理规则 is not a review line (it only means no order is prepared below the range), so both reports write 等待价格. Outside every zone, 接近区间 means within 3% of the nearest priced zone endpoint and 等待价格 means farther, computed from the numbers (Issue #306, 2026-10-18: GOOGL 2.7% below its floor was 等待价格 in Daily and 接近区间 in Weekly).

fields.name: 当前区间
fields.notes: Issue #298. Which of 入场计划 的 区间1/区间2/区间3 the current price currently falls in, or a short free-text note when it falls in none (e.g. between zones, above all zones). Blank whenever 执行状态 is blank.

fields.name: 需要复核
fields.notes: Issue #298. True when this row's reliably-selected active 入场计划 has hit its own 计划复核触发 condition or staleness rule and should get a Deep Dive refresh -- Weekly-computed; Daily may read but should not need to set this. When true, Weekly must also surface a corresponding 报告待办 row so the follow-up is actionable, not just a flag buried in 报告持仓. Deliberately NOT set true for the tied-maximum-版本 anomaly (入场计划's own rules) -- that case has no single reliably-identified plan version for 需要复核 to be about, so all five plan fields including this one stay blank/false, and the anomaly is reported exclusively through its own 报告待办 row. Blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank (no plan, or the tied-version anomaly) or the plan exists but 计划复核触发 could not itself be evaluated this run.

fields.name: 入场计划估值锚点
fields.notes: Issue #298. A verbatim, report-time snapshot of the referenced plan version's (入场计划ID's) own 长期估值锚点 field, copied by the writer at evaluation time -- never derived, reworded, or recomputed. This is what makes the plan anchor history-safe and Dashboard-renderable without a cross-tab join: 入场计划 rows are only ever superseded, never edited in place, but the Dashboard never reads 入场计划 directly (see that tab's own notes) -- this snapshot on 报告持仓 is the only copy it ever renders, matching the same snapshot discipline already used for 参考买入价/区间 (itself often snapshotted from 观察名单.理想买入区间). Blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank; also blank (never a fabricated placeholder) when the referenced plan's own 长期估值锚点 was itself unknown/blank.

fields.name: 入场计划版本
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. A verbatim snapshot of the referenced plan version's own 版本 (e.g. 2), copied at evaluation time -- same snapshot discipline as 入场计划估值锚点, never recomputed. Lets a human read 'plan v2' directly off the report row without decoding 入场计划ID's opaque id. Depends only on which plan version was selected, never on current price -- so it follows the SAME shape as 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点, not the 执行状态-dependent fields below: populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated (including the missing-evaluation-data case), blank only when 入场计划ID itself is blank.

fields.name: 入场计划数据时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. A verbatim snapshot of the referenced plan version's own 数据时间 (the Deep Dive date that plan version was created/materially updated), copied at evaluation time. Lets a reader judge plan age/staleness without joining back into 入场计划. Same shape as 入场计划版本 above -- depends only on plan selection, populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, blank only when 入场计划ID itself is blank.

fields.name: 行情截至时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text as-of label for the 当前价格 quote this evaluation used (e.g. '2026-10-13 收盘', or an exchange-local timestamp the data source supplied) -- distinct from 报告日期 because a quote can be delayed or sourced from a prior close while the report itself is dated today. Never fabricated to look more precise than the source actually was. Blank whenever there is no active plan, the active plan could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly), or this run's price data was itself unavailable -- in all three cases there is no quote to label (round 2 review correction: this field must never carry a '无法确认'/'计划未完善' diagnostic message itself -- 当前阻碍 carries that; this field only ever holds a genuine quote label or stays blank). Even when evaluation succeeded, this field may legitimately stay blank -- not an incomplete-plan case -- when the data source itself supplied no distinct as-of label beyond 报告日期; that is a property of the data source, not something the writer can supply by fabricating a time.

fields.name: 当前阻碍
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text, report-time blocked-explanation field -- round 2 review correction: unlike 执行状态/当前区间, this field is NOT blank merely because 执行状态 could not be computed; a reader needs a blocked explanation precisely when the execution enum is unavailable, not less so. Covers four situations, never a new investment judgment invented by the writer -- every one is derived from an already-known, already-documented fact: (1) no active plan exists for this 代码 -- a fixed, non-fabricated explanation that research/valuation is incomplete, and that any existing 参考买入价/区间 is not order authorization (Issue #303 scenario 1); (2) the active plan could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- an explanation that the plan needs manual cleanup, consistent with the 报告待办 flag already written for this case; (3) an active plan was reliably selected but this run's price/evaluation data was unavailable -- an explicit message starting with '无法确认：' naming what was missing (e.g. '无法确认：当前价格缺失'), never silently blank and never a fabricated guess; (4) an active plan was reliably selected and evaluated -- synthesized from the plan's own 技术确认条件/不追高条件/失效条件 plus the price/zone relationship, or an explicit message starting with '计划未完善：' when the plan itself doesn't specify the needed condition. The ONLY blank case is a reliably-selected, evaluated active plan at 执行状态=可小额开始 -- nothing is blocking.

fields.name: 下次检查
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text next check/remediation field -- round 2 review correction: like 当前阻碍, this field does NOT share 执行状态's blank shape, and in fact has no blank case of its own once schema_version 5 is adopted. Covers the same four situations as 当前阻碍: (1) no active plan -- names the remediation itself (complete research/valuation; have a Deep Dive establish a plan) rather than a date, restating that an existing reference price is not order authorization; (2) tied-version anomaly -- names waiting for the manual cleanup already flagged via 报告待办; (3) price/evaluation data unavailable -- an explicit '无法确认：' message naming what is being waited on (e.g. '无法确认：等待下次价格数据可用后重新评估'); (4) an active plan was reliably selected and evaluated, at ANY 执行状态 value including 可小额开始 -- sourced from the plan's own 下一验证证据/计划复核触发 (or a close-confirmation framing tied to 技术确认条件), which are plan facts independent of this run's price, so this content survives case (3) too once the plan itself is known; if the plan specifies neither, an explicit '计划未完善：' message rather than a blank cell or a guessed date. A condition being satisfied is a conclusion as of this evaluation's as-of time only, never a standing real-time signal -- manual review before acting is still required.

fields.name: 停止条件说明
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text snapshot explaining when this specific pending-entry attempt should be cancelled or paused, sourced from the plan's own 不追高条件/失效条件 -- round 2 review correction: both source conditions are plan facts independent of current price, so unlike 当前阻碍/下次检查 this field needs no missing-evaluation-data diagnostic of its own. It follows 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点/入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间's own shape instead: populated whenever an active plan was reliably selected (whether or not this run's price data was available), blank only when there is no active plan at all or it could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- nothing to state a stop condition about. Explicitly distinct from a sell signal on the existing holding -- cancelling/pausing a planned incremental buy is never the same as a decision to reduce or exit the position already held, and this field must never be worded to imply the latter. When a reliably-selected plan specifies neither 不追高条件 nor 失效条件, the writer must write an explicit incomplete-plan message (e.g. '计划未完善：未设置不追高条件或失效条件') rather than leaving the cell blank or fabricating a stop condition the plan never stated.

fields.name: 较上次变化说明
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text comparison against this 代码's immediately-previous live report row of the same 报告类型 (the most recent prior 报告ID whose 报告持仓 row for this 代码 was/is live per the read contract -- not necessarily the same 生成ID). Round 2 review correction: follows 停止条件说明's shape (populated whenever an active plan was reliably selected, independent of this run's price data), not 执行状态's shape. Distinguishes a plan-version change (入场计划ID differs from that prior row) from a fact-only change under the same plan version (e.g. price moved, 执行状态 changed) from this run's own price/evaluation data being unavailable (an explicit note, e.g. '无法确认：本次评估数据缺失，暂无法确定执行状态较上次的变化', never silently blank) from no material change at all (written concisely, e.g. '继续等待，无变化'). When there is no comparable prior report row for this 代码, the writer must say so explicitly (e.g. '首次评估，无可比历史') rather than fabricating a comparison. Blank only when there is no active plan at all or it could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- nothing to compare.

fields.name: 准备状态
values: 已有有效订单不重复建议
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2 (revised after PR #305 review, ten rounds). The central order-preparation state -- whether this row is ready for the user to manually prepare one order, computed by the writer via transparent mechanical lookup/arithmetic against an already-existing, traceable 入场计划 (never a new budget/threshold/entry-point decision -- see the narrowed Daily boundary in docs/v2.1-architecture.md). Decided in this fixed, fail-closed order: (0) no active plan at all, or it could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- blank, same shape as 入场计划版本; (1) an active plan was reliably selected but this run's price/evaluation data was unavailable (执行状态 itself blank for that reason, distinct from case 0) -- 无法确认; (2) 执行状态 is populated but is not 可小额开始 -- 无需准备 (nothing to prepare yet); (3) 执行状态=可小额开始: walk this zone's 区间N上一版本对应区间 chain (see 入场计划's own field notes and 入场执行反馈's own 对应区间 notes for the exact structured-mapping lookup -- it follows the explicit predecessor pointer at each version, not raw ordinal-label matching, so a zone that a revision reorders is still found) -- an explicit 已挂单/部分成交/已成交 status anywhere in that chain that has not expired is 已有有效订单不重复建议 unconditionally, with no remaining-capacity/剩余待成交数量 recomputation and no fresh 建议订单规模说明 for a partially filled zone (manual verification against 剩余待成交数量/交易记录/当前持仓 is the user's own next step, per that tab's rules); an explicit 未知 status, or an 已挂单/部分成交 whose 订单有效期截止 has passed with no newer row updating the status, is 无法确认; no row anywhere in the resolved chain is ALSO 无法确认, never a reason to proceed (缺少订单记录不等于不存在订单: the user may have placed a real broker order the system was never told about); a chain step whose own 区间N上一版本对应区间 is blank when the write invariant required it non-blank is an unresolved mapping -- fail closed to 无法确认, never fall back to guessing by ordinal position; only an explicit 未下单/已取消 status at the head of the chain is affirmative evidence that no order occupies this zone's tranche, and even that is fail-closed on THREE separate conditions: freshness (if its 数据时间 predates the active plan version's own 数据时间, it is stale and the result is 无法确认, reconfirm under the current version) AND fill history (PR #305 round 7 review, corrected round 8: if ANY row ever recorded for this exact (计划ID,区间) key -- including this 未下单/已取消 row itself -- has a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量, OR has a 订单状态 of 部分成交/已成交 (已成交数量 is optional per 入场执行反馈's own field notes -- blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero,' so the STATUS alone is itself fill evidence even when no quantity was ever supplied), this is not safely clear; a 已取消/未下单 report describes the now-cancelled/never-placed REMAINDER of an order, never a reversal of shares already bought, so a prior fill -- by quantity or by status alone -- is real, irreversible capital that this status can never erase -- even when the cancelling row itself leaves 已成交数量 blank, an earlier row's recorded fill still counts, since silence on the cancellation is not evidence the fill didn't happen; the result is 无法确认, manual reconciliation against 已成交数量/交易记录/当前持仓 required, never 可准备订单 on the strength of an unexamined cancellation) AND affirmative zero-fill confirmation (PR #305 round 9 review, corrected round 10: this tab has no broker synchronization, so once this key's history shows ANY status implying an order existed -- 已挂单/部分成交/已成交, OR 已取消 itself, since cancelling something implies it existed to be cancelled (round 10: a key whose first/only ever report is 已取消 is NOT exempt just because IOS never separately saw a 已挂单 row for it) -- a later 已取消/未下单 with no recorded fill evidence is STILL not safe to treat as clear; a partial fill could have occurred before that clearing report and simply never been disclosed; the clearing 未下单/已取消 row itself must affirmatively state 已成交数量=0, an explicit zero rather than a blank, before this key counts as reconciled, else 无法确认; only a key whose ENTIRE history is 未下单 (never 已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消 at all, including on the row itself) has nothing that could have filled, so it is exempt from this explicit-zero requirement); only a fresh, affirmative 未下单/已取消 with NO recorded fill evidence anywhere in that key's history, AND (when any row in that key's history implies an order existed) an explicit 已成交数量=0 on the clearing row, lets the writer continue to case (4); (4) with no order already occupying this zone's tranche per case (3), check the plan's own 订单类型/订单有效期/计划新增仓位金额/计划新增仓位币种, plus the manual preflight confirmations 交易单位确认 and 订单类型可用性确认 (always required), plus 换汇可行性确认 (required only when 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the funding account's own 币种 in 账户状态) -- a confirmation counts as present only if it is also fresh (0-30 days old, never future-dated) and account-matched against the single shared 订单资金账户 field: see 交易单位确认时间/订单类型可用性确认时间/换汇可行性确认时间 and 订单资金账户's own field notes for the exact rule (PR #305 round 4 finding #1, corrected round 5 -- round 4's per-field 换汇可行性确认账户 left 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认 unbound to any account, and its freshness check let a future-dated confirmation pass) -- a stale, future-dated, unbound, or account-mismatched confirmation is treated exactly like a blank one, never silently honored because the text field itself is non-blank; all required fields non-blank AND fresh AND (where applicable) account-matched continues to case (5); any one blank/stale/mismatched is 计划未完善停在核对 instead -- the writer must never fabricate a missing order parameter or preflight confirmation, nor backdate a confirmation's own timestamp, to reach 可准备订单 (PR #305 round 3 review finding #2: these manual, user-authorized confirmations are how this system checks trading unit, order-type support, and conversion feasibility without a broker integration -- never a standing disclaimer in place of an actual check); (5) plan-level budget reservation across the WHOLE plan lineage (PR #305 round 4 finding #2, corrected round 5 -- round 4 only ever walked the active version's own sibling zones, which misses a historical zone that has NO successor in the active version at all, e.g. a predecessor's 区间3 with a live order that the active version simply dropped rather than continuing under any label): first, walk the chain (case (3)'s mechanism) for every zone of the ACTIVE version with a non-blank 区间N价格 (not only the zone being prepared), recording every (计划ID, 区间) pair visited by any of those walks as 'claimed'; second, collect every (计划ID, 区间) pair across the ENTIRE lineage (the active version and every ancestor reachable via 上一版本ID) that has a non-blank 区间N价格, and for every such pair NOT in 'claimed' ('orphaned' -- no active-version zone's chain ever reaches it), walk a chain from THAT pair too (the same way, since an orphan can itself have its own further predecessor), adding everything it visits to 'claimed' as well, until no unclaimed pairs remain. Any orphan chain that resolves unresolved (no row anywhere in it, 未知, expired-unconfirmed, or an unresolved mapping) makes the active plan's total consumption unbounded, exactly as an unresolved sibling does -- the zone being prepared is ALSO 无法确认. Every live, unexpired 已挂单/部分成交/已成交 found -- whether via a sibling's chain or an orphan's -- contributes its reserved amount from the HISTORICAL plan version actually named by that feedback row's own 关联计划ID (that version's own 区间{label}占比 x that SAME version's own 计划新增仓位金额, never recomputed against the active version's possibly-different numbers) -- BUT ONLY when that historical version's own 计划新增仓位币种 is IDENTICAL to the active version's own 计划新增仓位币种 (PR #305 round 6 review finding #1): a plan revision that changed the stated currency makes that historical reservation's amount impossible to net against the active budget as a raw number (10,000 of one currency is not 10,000 of another), and this system does no currency conversion, so a currency-mismatched historical reservation is itself unresolved -- the whole budget calculation fails closed exactly as an unresolved chain does, never summed in as an unconverted number; a chain resolving to a fresh, affirmative 未下单/已取消, or to 新增资金, contributes zero. Sum every claimed pair's reserved amount (excluding the zone being prepared itself), subtract from the active version's own 计划新增仓位金额 to get the remaining plan budget, and compare against the zone being prepared's own order amount (its 区间N占比 x the active version's own 计划新增仓位金额): exceeding the remaining plan budget is 无法确认 (name the shortfall -- reservations found, plan total, and amount needed -- in 当前阻碍), never 可准备订单 on a budget check that only ever looked at the active version's own zones; staying within it continues to case (6); (6) cash preflight: 账户状态 must affirmatively show 可用现金 for the EXACT account named by 订单资金账户 (round 5, PR #305 review finding #1 -- never just any 账户状态 row that happens to match the currency, since two accounts can share a currency) that covers the computed order size, subject to TWO further checks round 6 found missing: (a) currency match -- that account's own 账户状态.币种 must be IDENTICAL to 计划新增仓位币种, never merely compared as raw numbers across currencies (this system does no FX conversion, so a JPY balance can never be read as covering a USD order no matter how large the JPY number is); (b) freshness -- that account's own 数据时间 must satisfy 0 <= (报告日期 - 数据时间) <= 7 days (a tighter window than the 30-day one used for the manual confirmations above, since a cash balance moves far more often than trading-unit/order-type/conversion facts, and this system runs daily) and must not be future-dated. No matching account, a currency mismatch, missing/future/stale 数据时间, or a clearly insufficient amount are all 无法确认 (round 2 finding #3: an unknown required input blocks the same as a known-insufficient one; name the shortfall or missing/stale data in 当前阻碍); only a confirmed-sufficient, currency-matched, fresh figure on that exact account reaches 可准备订单, which by this point means every one of #303's named preflight dimensions (cash, currency conversion, trading unit, order type, existing-order reservation, and plan-wide remaining budget across the whole lineage) has been affirmatively checked against the SAME funding account -- never silently assumed fine. Issue #306 price-policy preflight (maintainer decision A): before 可准备订单 can be reached, the current zone's 区间N价格 must itself state a single price or an explicit maximum (e.g. '≤180'), or the plan's own 订单类型 must explicitly state that the zone's range upper bound is that batch's maximum limit price; a bare range with no such explicit rule routes to 计划未完善停在核对 -- the order-limit path may never promote a range's upper bound to a limit price that the conditional 计划买入上限 display would itself call ambiguous.

fields.name: 建议限价
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. The applicable zone's own maximum limit price, copied/derived verbatim from the matching 入场计划.区间N价格 -- a transparent mechanical lookup, never a price Daily/Weekly computes or estimates independently. Populated only when 准备状态=可准备订单; blank in every other case, including 计划未完善停在核对 (the zone price may be known but the plan lacks other order parameters, so nothing is actually ready to prepare). Issue #306 (decision A): when 区间N价格 is a range, the upper bound is copied only if the plan's 订单类型 explicitly states that the range upper bound is the batch's maximum limit price (noting that basis, e.g. '11 USD（区间1 上沿，按计划订单类型规则）'); otherwise 准备状态 never reaches 可准备订单, so this field stays blank.

fields.name: 建议订单规模说明
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text order size derived by pure mechanical arithmetic -- the matching zone's 区间N占比 as a percentage of 入场计划.计划新增仓位金额 in 计划新增仓位币种 (e.g. '约 10,000 USD（区间1 占比 50% x 计划基数 20,000 USD）') -- never an executed share count, never a figure Daily/Weekly sets independently. Populated only when 准备状态=可准备订单, same shape as 建议限价. By that point (PR #305 round 3 review finding #2, extended round 4) every one of #303's named preflight dimensions has already been affirmatively checked by 准备状态's own decision steps: cash sufficiency, currency match, and freshness (0-7 days old, never future-dated) against the exact 账户状态 row named by 入场计划.订单资金账户 (round 6 finding #2), 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 against 入场计划's own manual confirmation fields (fresh -- 0 to 30 days old, never future-dated -- and bound to that same 订单资金账户, round 5 finding #1), and the plan's own remaining budget after subtracting what every other zone across the WHOLE plan lineage, including historical zones with no successor in the active version and excluding any whose own 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the active version's (round 5 finding #2, round 6 finding #1), has already reserved or consumed -- this field no longer needs a standing disclaimer for any of them, since a disclaimer in place of an actual check was exactly what round 2's version of this field got wrong. If a future preflight dimension is ever added without a corresponding confirmation field, it must gate 准备状态 the same way, never ride along as a disclaimer on this field instead.

fields.name: 计划订单有效期
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Verbatim snapshot of the referenced plan version's own 入场计划.订单有效期 policy -- never reworded or recomputed, same snapshot discipline as 入场计划估值锚点. Follows 入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间's shape: populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, independent of whether this run's price data was available, since it is a plan policy fact rather than a this-run evaluation result.

fields.name: 跳空处理提示
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text note applying the plan's own 入场计划.跳空处理规则 when this run's price appears to have gapped past a zone's limit since the last evaluation -- restates the plan's existing policy, never invents a new gap rule or raises a limit price to chase the gap. Blank whenever no gap-past-limit condition applies this run, or when the plan itself has no 跳空处理规则 stated (in which case a gapped row's 当前阻碍 should carry a 计划未完善 note instead of this field fabricating a rule).

fields.name: 最近订单状态
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Verbatim snapshot of the most recent relevant 入场执行反馈 row's own 订单状态 for this 代码 and zone, copied at evaluation time -- never derived, reworded, or inferred from price action. Blank whenever no 入场执行反馈 row exists for this 代码/zone yet (a missing row is a distinct state from an explicit 未知 value -- see that tab's own rules), or whenever 入场计划ID itself is blank.

fields.name: 今日行动
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 7. schema_version 9 (Issue #318) adds 本周无购买区间 (今日建议=等待) for rows written in three_layer mode only (contract mapping T7/T8); a row written in legacy mode never carries it and keeps the v8 mapping below unchanged. Issue #337 adds 沿用定投 (今日建议=沿用定投, no column change, no schema_version bump) for the 代码=FUND-SLEEVE aggregate row only: step (0), before (1) in every mode (T0 in three_layer), applies when 代码=FUND-SLEEVE, 入场计划ID is blank, the 入场计划 tab was read with zero 状态=active rows for FUND-SLEEVE and, in three_layer mode, 周度购买计划 was read with zero 状态=active rows for it. Tsumitate evidence binds by 账户: with the FUND-SLEEVE row's 账户 set, only 投资信托明细 and 账户状态 rows of that 账户 count; with it blank, every detail row counts and each detail row's own 账户 needs evidence (a detail row without 账户 cannot bind). Each such 账户 needs exactly one 账户状态 row with non-blank 定期定额扣款, carrying a 数据时间 -- none, more than one, or no date is a gap, never resolved by row order or by another account. It writes 先核对缺项 with 当前阻碍 starting 基金聚合数据缺口： (naming the gap, the 账户 and the dates present, linking one 基金数据补录： todo) on any gap, or when an in-scope detail row has blank 当前市值/数据时间 -- otherwise 沿用定投. A tab that cannot be read never proves no plan: the row is then out of scope (or a data gap), never a crash. A 沿用定投 row is consistent only with 代码=FUND-SLEEVE, 周计划状态=无周计划 in a three-layer generation (the one exception to T0 leaving it blank) and blank in legacy, blank 入场计划ID/周计划ID/周计划版本/周计划结论/周计划执行路径/周计划适用周/周计划研究截至/周计划复核时间/周计划复核方式/价格参考结论/价格参考下沿/价格参考上沿/执行状态/准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期/计划买入下限/计划买入上限/当前阻碍, 阻塞待办ID=无 and 今日行动说明 containing 不是额外申购授权; the writer's pre-publish check 8 and the Dashboard apply this same predicate to the row snapshot, and any failure is 无法判断; the writer also cross-checks the 入场计划/周度购买计划 tables it read against that snapshot. A missing 入场计划, long-term valuation or weekly plan never blocks this row; an extra one-time purchase is research on a specific fund under its own 代码 and never flows through this row. Rule text: the identical section 基金聚合行的适用边界与待办关闭修订 in both report prompts. The single, canonical primary conclusion for this row -- what the user should do in the current trading session -- written by the report-generation layer (Daily/Weekly) via a fixed, total, safety-first mapping over fields this same row already carries plus one explicit, traceable lookup (the count of 状态=active 入场计划 rows for this 代码, from the same 入场计划 read the writer already performs for plan selection), never a new investment judgment and never re-derived by the Dashboard from several enums. Mapping, first match wins: (1) 入场计划ID blank AND the 入场计划 tab was read successfully this run AND it has zero 状态=active rows for this 代码 -> 无入场计划 (no planned incremental buy to act on; never a sell signal on an existing holding); (2) 入场计划ID blank in every other case -- one or more 状态=active rows exist for this 代码 but none could be reliably selected (the tied-maximum-版本 anomaly), or the 入场计划 tab could not be read -> 先核对缺项. Cases (1) and (2) share the same blank 报告持仓 row shape under the #298/#303 contract, so they are distinguished only by that explicit active-row count, never by an inferred, remembered, or out-of-band flag, and never by parsing 当前阻碍's free text; (3) 准备状态=可准备订单 AND 执行状态=可小额开始 AND (schema_version 8) the active plan's 订单类型 declares exactly one 执行路径 -> 可人工准备限价单 (no declared execution path -> 先核对缺项); 准备状态=可准备订单 with 执行状态=暂停复核 -> 暂停新增待复核 (a paused plan never advertises preparing a new order); 准备状态=可准备订单 with any other or blank 执行状态 -> 先核对缺项 (self-contradictory row, fail closed); (4) 准备状态=已有有效订单不重复建议 -> 已有订单勿重复; (5) 准备状态=无法确认 or 计划未完善停在核对 -> 先核对缺项; (6) 执行状态=暂停复核 -> 暂停新增待复核 (pausing a planned incremental buy, never a decision to reduce the holding); (7) 执行状态=等待确认 -> 等待确认 only when (schema_version 8) the active plan's 订单类型 declares exactly one 执行路径, otherwise -> 先核对缺项 (with no declared path there is no condition to confirm); a missing or duplicated execution path changes no other branch: 已有订单勿重复, 暂停新增待复核, 先核对缺项 and 等待价格 stay exactly as mapped; (8) 执行状态=等待价格 or 接近区间 -> 等待价格; (9) any other combination (including 执行状态=可小额开始 with 准备状态 blank or unrecognized) -> 先核对缺项 (fail closed). 可小额开始 is therefore never itself a primary conclusion: it is a secondary plan-condition state, and only 准备状态=可准备订单 together with 执行状态=可小额开始 can produce 可人工准备限价单. Populated on every newly written schema_version 7 row (no blank case); blank only on rows written before this column existed, which a reader must render with that row's own historical layout, never re-derive. A reader shows an unrecognized value neutrally, never as ready-to-buy, and shows 可人工准备限价单 as ready only when the same row also carries 执行状态=可小额开始, 准备状态=可准备订单 and non-blank 建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期 -- a contradictory row renders a neutral 'state contradiction, check first' state and a row missing order fields a neutral incomplete-order state naming them, never an order synthesized from other fields.

fields.name: 今日行动说明
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 7. One short free-text sentence carrying 今日行动's concrete next step and timing: what to do now, on which market trading day and in which exchange timezone to re-check or act, and what already-defined plan rule applies once the condition is met. Composed only from facts this row already carries (当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/计划订单有效期/跳空处理提示 and the active plan's own 技术确认条件/订单类型/订单有效期/跳空处理规则) -- never a new condition, date, price, or order parameter. Must name the one execution path the plan actually defines: a valuation-zone limit path (when a manual limit order may be prepared, the maximum price, and validity); a close-confirmation path (exchange and timezone, the official-close observation window and verifiable condition, the check day T, and that a limit order per the plan is prepared for the next exchange trading day T+1 -- an after-hours or pre-market quote never substitutes for the official close, and an exchange holiday moves T/T+1 to the next exchange trading day); or an event-confirmation path (re-review after the named disclosure/event; never implies buying the moment it happens when execution parameters are missing). For 可人工准备限价单 it must say the order is reviewed and submitted manually by the user, a gap open above the limit is not chased and the limit is never raised, and an unfilled/partially filled order follows its validity and order feedback rather than being re-suggested. For 先核对缺项 it names what is missing. For 已有订单勿重复 it says not to place a duplicate and to reconcile with the broker. For 无入场计划/暂停新增待复核 it states this is not a sell instruction for any existing holding. For 沿用定投 (Issue #337) it quotes 账户状态.定期定额扣款 with the 账户状态 and 投资信托明细 dates and states it is not an authorization for an extra purchase. Same shape as 今日行动: populated whenever 今日行动 is populated.

fields.name: 计划买入上限
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 7. Conditional plan cap, NOT an order limit; 建议限价 still populates only at 准备状态=可准备订单 and the cap must equal it then. Batch selection is fail-closed: use one unambiguous next batch explicitly declared by the active plan's own 订单类型 (e.g. 下一执行批次=区间2 or 本轮只有区间2获配资金). Conflicting declarations or contradictions with the plan budget/zone definitions yield 需补全. Without that explicit declaration, require 当前区间 to equal exactly one zone label. Never infer the batch from ordinal order, a sole nonblank price, or budget size. The selected batch's feedback lineage must be resolved at every level (records present, no 未知, expired-unconfirmed orders or missing required pointers), and its price must state a single price or an explicit maximum; a range upper bound is allowed only under the plan's explicit upper-bound-as-limit policy, with that basis noted. Otherwise name the gap using 需补全. An explicitly declared next batch's conditional cap does not require the quote to be inside its zone, or even available. Preserve current-zone/execution/preparation states and every funding, feedback, price, time and event gate; show the applicable range and blockers and label it 尚不可据此下单 unless 今日行动=可人工准备限价单. Blank only without a reliably selected plan. Never substitute the quote, previous close or valuation anchor. The feedback lineage is resolved once per (计划ID, 区间) and shared by 准备状态 step 4, this cap and 计划买入下限 (Issue #306, 2026-10-18): each level counts only its own (计划ID, 区间) records, so an older version's confirmation never stands in for a newer version's missing record; a blank pointer on a version with 上一版本ID is a missing pointer; merging several old zones into one new zone covers only the zone the pointer names. Unresolved lineage gives the same 需补全 (no price range) and a linked feedback todo in both Daily and Weekly, never a silently inherited or ignored gap.

fields.name: 行情属性
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. Session attribute of the 当前价格 quote, shown next to it on the first screen so a reader never takes a delayed, after-hours or previous-close quote for a live order price: 盘中 (intraday), 正式收盘 (the exchange's official close), 盘后/盘前 (extended-hours), 过期 (older than the most recent exchange session the report could expect, e.g. a quote from two sessions ago), 未知 (the source does not say). Populated whenever 当前价格 is non-blank, for every row (with or without a plan); blank exactly when 当前价格 is blank. Never upgraded to look fresher than the source was.

fields.name: 报价币种
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. ISO currency code of 当前价格 (e.g. USD, JPY), copied from the data source or the holding's own 币种. Populated whenever 当前价格 is non-blank; blank exactly when 当前价格 is blank.

fields.name: 计划买入下限
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. Lower end of the first-screen 建议买入范围, taken from the SAME batch and the same fail-closed selection/lineage conditions as 计划买入上限 -- never from a different batch, the valuation anchor, the previous close or the quote. A batch whose 区间N价格 is a range: its lower endpoint verbatim plus the zone label (e.g. '165 USD（区间2）'). A single price is copied here only when the plan's 订单类型 explicitly declares it the only allowed price (then 下限 = 上限); a single price or explicit maximum without that declaration yields '需补全：计划只规定最高出价 X，未规定最低价' -- the cap is never copied down to fake a two-sided range. Any other gap uses a 需补全： reason. A missing lower bound is a display gap, not a buy gate and not a 阻塞待办ID entry: whether buying below the range pauses or re-reviews the plan is decided by the plan, never by a new blanket rule. Blank only without a reliably selected plan.

fields.name: 阻塞待办ID
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. The 报告待办.待办ID values (same 报告ID and 生成ID) of every todo that blocks this row's 今日建议, separated by '、' or ','; the literal 无 when nothing blocks (blank or a missing column never counts as 无). Required non-blank on every newly written schema_version 8 row; blank only on rows written before this column existed. Every listed ID must exist in the same generation's 报告待办 with a non-completed 状态. 今日建议=无法判断, a 需补全 in 计划买入上限, and a plan with no declared execution path each require at least one ID whose todo names that exact gap; 适合买入 and 沿用定投 (Issue #337) require 无. A 需补全 in 计划买入下限 alone is a display gap, not a blocker: it is never listed here and never changes 今日建议 (its plan-maintenance todo is written as a separate, non-blocking todo). A reader resolves IDs only inside the generation being shown (current or history) and renders a missing, completed or unresolvable link as an explicit link anomaly, never as 'no blocker'. 无 means no unresolved prerequisite that would still prevent execution once the price condition is met, not only the primary branch's gap (Issue #306, 2026-10-18): a shared prerequisite todo (分类=执行前置, its 待办 text listing 适用代码：A、B、C -- cash on an 订单资金账户 covers every active plan funded from that account with 计划新增仓位金额 > 0; feedback and execution-timing todos cover their plan) is linked from every row it covers, e.g. CASH-01, even while price remains the primary waiting reason. Only existing gates are linked; no new prerequisite is created. Rows whose 今日行动 is 等待价格/等待确认/已有订单勿重复 link only 分类=执行前置 todos (execution-timing todos use that category too) and, when the plan's own review line or 失效条件 has fired, its 分类=计划复核 todo; a research, risk or watch todo the plan does not define as an entry or review condition is never linked (Weekly linked the ORCL Jupiter research todo, Daily did not). 先核对缺项/暂停新增待复核/无入场计划 rows link the todo that decided the branch first. A shared cash prerequisite that the plan says is still being completed (top-up or FX pending) is unverified, not failed: it never turns the row into 暂停复核.

fields.name: 周计划ID

rules: 资产类型=watchlist rows must never be aggregated or rendered as holdings.

For newly written 资产类型=watchlist rows, IOS状态 is the report-provided canonical recommended next action: exactly 研究建仓 / 等待估值 / 等待价格 / 继续观察 / 降低优先级. 优先级 and 价格位置 are independent fields; no Dashboard or other reader may infer IOS状态 from them, prices, or styling. Historical rows retain their stored IOS状态 verbatim; blank/unrecognized legacy values use a neutral presentation fallback rather than being recomputed.
A row whose 生成ID does not match the current 报告摘要 pointer for its 报告ID is stale/orphaned and must never be rendered or aggregated.

参考买入价/区间, 当前价格, and 价格位置 are informational reference data, not investment advice or an executable target -- see the Book/Prompt Suite's own 'all actual investment actions require human confirmation' boundary. A writer must never fabricate any of the three when its source data is unavailable.

入场计划ID/执行状态/当前区间/需要复核/入场计划估值锚点 (Issue #298) are a second, independent presentation track layered on top of 参考买入价/区间/价格位置, not a replacement of them in the schema -- when an active 入场计划 exists for a 代码, these five fields are the primary display and 参考买入价/区间/价格位置 are not rendered for that row at all; when no active plan exists, 参考买入价/区间/价格位置 remain the sole display exactly as before this feature existed. A reader must never show both a plan-based state and a legacy reference-price badge as two competing top-level recommendations for the same row.

These five fields follow exactly three field-value shapes, never a fourth improvised combination: (1) no active plan for this 代码 -- all five blank/false, legacy display used. (2) an active plan was reliably selected but this run's evaluation data (e.g. current price) was insufficient -- 入场计划ID and 入场计划估值锚点 stay populated (they depend only on which plan version was selected, never on current price), 执行状态/当前区间 stay blank, 需要复核 is set independently from the plan's own 计划复核触发 condition where that can itself be judged. (3) the tied-maximum-版本 anomaly (see 入场计划's own rules) -- shaped identically to case (1) (all five blank/false), with the anomaly reported only via a 报告待办 row, never by setting 需要复核 true on an otherwise-blank plan row. A writer must never blank 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点 merely because 执行状态 could not be computed (that recreates the legacy-fallback/competing-badge failure mode this feature exists to prevent), and must never set 需要复核 true without 入场计划ID also being populated.

Issue #303 Phase 1 adds seven further optional columns (入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间/行情截至时间/当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明), introduced in schema_version 5, layered on top of the five Issue #298 fields above. These seven fields follow THREE different shapes, not one uniform rule -- a round 2 review correction to an earlier draft that wrongly forced all seven to blank whenever 执行状态 was blank, which silently dropped the required report-time blocked-explanation/remediation content for exactly the cases that most need it (no active plan; a tied-version anomaly; an active plan whose evaluation data was unavailable this run). (a) 入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间 follow 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点's own shape: populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, blank only when there is no active plan or it could not be reliably selected. (b) 停止条件说明/较上次变化说明 follow that SAME 入场计划ID shape, not 执行状态's shape -- both are derivable from the plan's own stated conditions or from comparing plan identity/facts across reports, neither of which requires this run's price to be available; populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, blank only alongside it. (c) 行情截至时间 is populated only when this run actually used a priced quote, so it is blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank, the plan could not be reliably selected, OR this run's price data was itself unavailable -- and may legitimately stay blank even when evaluation succeeded, if the data source supplied no distinct as-of label beyond 报告日期 (a property of the data source, not an incomplete-plan case). (d) 当前阻碍/下次检查 follow neither shape above -- they are the report's blocked-explanation/remediation fields and must carry content in every situation where something needs explaining, INCLUDING when there is no active plan at all (explaining that research/valuation is incomplete and an existing 参考买入价/区间 is not order authorization) and when an active plan exists but this run's evaluation data was unavailable (an explicit 无法确认： message naming what was missing). 当前阻碍's only blank case is a reliably-selected, evaluated active plan at 执行状态=可小额开始 (nothing is blocking); 下次检查 has no blank case of its own once schema_version 5 is adopted -- even at 可小额开始 it still names the next check/remediation step, sourced from the plan's own 下一验证证据/计划复核触发 when a plan exists and was evaluated. Whenever 当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明 are expected to carry plan-condition-derived content (an active plan was reliably selected) but the plan itself does not specify the underlying condition (技术确认条件/不追高条件/失效条件/下一验证证据/计划复核触发 all blank, as relevant to that field), the writer must write an explicit incomplete-plan message (free text beginning with 计划未完善：) rather than leaving the cell blank. This is distinct from the 无法确认： message used when evaluation data (not the plan itself) was the missing ingredient, and from the fixed no-active-plan/tied-anomaly wording -- a reader tells these three situations apart by which message prefix appears, never by a blank cell. These rules never retroactively change the three-shape contract for the original five Issue #298 fields.

Issue #303 Phase 2 adds six further optional columns (准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期/跳空处理提示/最近订单状态), introduced in schema_version 6, layered on top of Phase 1's seven columns -- none of this is a trading instruction or an executed order; it is order-preparation information the user still must confirm and submit manually. 计划订单有效期/最近订单状态 follow 入场计划版本's shape (populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, independent of this run's price data, since both are snapshots of policy/feedback facts rather than this-run evaluation results). 准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/跳空处理提示 depend on 执行状态 being populated and, for 建议限价/建议订单规模说明 specifically, on 准备状态 being exactly 可准备订单 -- see each field's own notes for the exact conditions. The narrowed Daily boundary (docs/v2.1-architecture.md) applies to all six: a writer may only perform transparent mechanical lookup/arithmetic against an already-existing, traceable, human-confirmed 入场计划 and 入场执行反馈 -- it must never set a new budget, threshold, entry price, or order parameter of its own, and must never treat a missing plan parameter as license to invent one. PR #305 review corrections (ten rounds): 准备状态's decision is fail-closed on missing/unknown/stale 入场执行反馈 and on an existing partial fill (never falls through to 可准备订单 in those cases, and never recomputes a partially filled zone's remaining size), and a later 已取消/未下单 report never erases an earlier recorded fill at the same key, whether that fill was recorded as a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量 OR evidenced solely by a 部分成交/已成交 订单状态 with no quantity ever supplied (已成交数量 is optional -- blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero') -- that capital is real and irreversible either way, so a cancellation of the unfilled remainder is 无法确认 pending manual reconciliation, never a green light to prepare the original full tranche again (round 7 finding, corrected round 8 to also cover status-only evidence); beyond that, since this tab has no broker synchronization, a key whose history shows any status implying an order existed (已挂单/部分成交/已成交, OR 已取消 itself -- round 10 finding: a key whose first/only report is 已取消 is not exempt just because IOS never separately saw a 已挂单 row) cannot be trusted as genuinely cleared by a later 已取消/未下单 on silence alone -- an undisclosed partial fill could have occurred before that report -- so the clearing row must itself affirmatively state 已成交数量=0 (round 9 finding; a key whose entire history is 未下单 with no order-existed status at all is exempt, since nothing could have filled); it walks each zone's structured 区间N上一版本对应区间 predecessor chain (never raw ordinal-label matching) to find an existing order across a plan revision, including one a revision reorders; it runs a cash preflight against the exact 账户状态 row named by 入场计划.订单资金账户 (round 5 finding #1 -- never any row that merely matches currency), requiring that row's own 币种 to exactly match 计划新增仓位币种 (never a raw cross-currency number comparison, round 6 finding #1) and its own 数据时间 to be within a 7-day, non-future-dated freshness window (round 6 finding #2), plus the manual 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 preflight confirmations, checked for freshness (0-30 days old, never future-dated -- round 5 corrected an age check a future date could trivially satisfy) and bound to that same 订单资金账户; and it aggregates reserved/consumed amounts across the WHOLE plan lineage -- not just the active version's own sibling zones, but every historical zone with no successor in the active version too (round 5 finding #2), excluding (fail-closed) any historical reservation whose own 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the active version's (round 6 finding #1) -- using each live order's own historical plan-version numbers, not the current version's -- to compute a remaining plan budget before confirming 可准备订单 -- see 准备状态/建议订单规模说明's own notes, 入场计划's own rules, and 入场执行反馈's own rules for the exact mechanics.

Issue #306 adds three further optional columns (今日行动/今日行动说明/计划买入上限), introduced in schema_version 7, appended after 最近订单状态. They separate four kinds of price a reader must never confuse: the market quote (当前价格 + 行情截至时间, never an order price), the long-term valuation anchor (入场计划估值锚点, a research judgment, never an order limit), the conditional plan cap (计划买入上限, not orderable unless 今日行动=可人工准备限价单), and the validated order limit (建议限价, only at 准备状态=可准备订单, still reviewed and submitted manually). 今日行动 is the one primary conclusion: a reader renders it (with 今日行动说明, the price-discipline line, 当前阻碍, and plan/quote freshness) first, and moves research narrative, valuation derivation, 执行状态, quotes, and change details into a secondary, collapsed-by-default layer -- 执行状态=可小额开始 is never rendered as a competing green primary action on such a row. When the plan itself is insufficient to give a price or prepare an order, 今日行动说明 names the specific plan fields a Weekly Deep Dive must complete, and Weekly writes one 报告待办 (跟进类型=可执行) per such 代码. A reader never derives 今日行动 or a price from other fields; a row without 今日行动 (written before schema_version 7) keeps its own historical layout, and history always shows the stored snapshot, never today's plan or order state.

Issue #306 (schema_version 8) adds four further optional columns (行情属性/报价币种/计划买入下限/阻塞待办ID) after 计划买入上限, plus 报告待办.待办ID, for the user-confirmed five-item first screen: (1) the report-time quote with currency, as-of time and session attribute, never an order price; (2) 今日建议, exactly one of 适合买入 / 等待 / 无法判断 (plus 沿用定投 for the FUND-SLEEVE aggregate row, Issue #337: 今日行动=沿用定投 on a row passing the 沿用定投 consistency predicate in 今日行动's notes, otherwise 无法判断; never a buy verdict), given by the fixed shared mapping over 今日行动 -- 可人工准备限价单 -> 适合买入 only when the same row also has 执行状态=可小额开始, 准备状态=可准备订单, non-blank 建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期 and 阻塞待办ID is the literal 无 (blank or missing never counts; otherwise 无法判断); 等待价格/等待确认/已有订单勿重复/暂停新增待复核 -> 等待; 先核对缺项/无入场计划/blank/unknown -> 无法判断 -- the mapping is stored nowhere else and a reader never invents another verdict; (3) 建议买入范围 = 计划买入下限 and 计划买入上限 of one batch, each shown with its own 需补全 reason when missing, labelled 尚不可据此下单 unless 今日建议=适合买入; (4) the waiting reason (今日行动说明) for 等待; (5) the reason a verdict or price cannot be generated plus links to the exact blocker todos (阻塞待办ID), or an explicit 无. Everything else (valuation anchor, plan version, research text, internal enums, lineage, order size/validity/path) is folded by default. A history generation shows its own snapshot labelled 当时建议 with its own date. Before publishing a generation the writer runs the pre-publish consistency checks of both report prompts and never publishes a row that fails them: 执行状态 vs zones, 今日行动 vs the fixed mapping, the 可人工准备限价单 completeness/consistency, blocker links resolving inside the same generation, two-sided range from one batch, quote attribute/currency present with the quote, and no self-contradicting free text in the same row.

No historical row is backfilled; old rows are interpreted by their own snapshot forever.

schema_version 10 (Issue #327) appends thirteen optional display columns after 已核验暂停记录ID (价格参考结论/价格参考下沿/价格参考上沿/价格参考币种/价格参考支撑/价格参考阻力/价格参考确认条件/价格参考否定条件/价格参考趋势环境/价格参考出处/价格参考缺口/价格参考与上限关系/价格参考位置). fields.notes: Completion state (free text; canonical completed-equivalent values are 已完成/done -- see the GAS Dashboard's own classifier). Orthogonal to 跟进类型 below: a 持续观察/等待证据 row normally stays 待处理 for as long as the condition it describes remains active, and only moves to 已完成 once that follow-up itself is genuinely concluded.

Distinguishes actionable work the user/Agent can advance now from an ongoing monitoring condition (e.g. 'continue tracking NVIDIA Rubin ramp/margins') and an item genuinely blocked on an external event (e.g. a pending board decision or filing) -- so the Dashboard's todo/backlog view doesn't misrepresent recurring monitoring or an evidence-wait as accumulating unfinished work. Blank or any value outside this enum is treated as 可执行 by any reader (the safe, conservative default -- never silently hidden from the actionable backlog). Canonical machine values are these literal Chinese strings; the GAS Dashboard renders them, it does not translate or reinterpret them. Placed after 备注 (rather than in narrative field order) because this column was added via the additive, append-only schema_version 3 upgrade -- an existing installation's 报告待办 header gets this column appended at the end, so the canonical field order here must match physical append position exactly (see PR #268 review).

fields.name: 待办ID
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. Identifier of this todo, unique within its (报告ID, 生成ID), so a 报告持仓 row can link the exact blocker through 阻塞待办ID instead of a mutable row number or a vague category (recommended form: <代码 or GEN>-<sequence>, e.g. 8001-1). Required non-blank on every newly written schema_version 8 todo; blank only on rows written before this column existed, which no 阻塞待办ID can reference. Placed after 跟进类型 because it is appended by the additive schema_version 8 upgrade.

rules: A row whose 生成ID does not match the current 报告摘要 pointer for its 报告ID is stale/orphaned and must never be rendered or aggregated.

Issue #337: closing a todo (状态 -> 已完成, including closing it as not applicable) that a 报告持仓.阻塞待办ID in the live generation links is a report revision, not a cell edit: the writer publishes a new generation of the same 报告ID under report_write_protocol, restaging every row; the closed todo keeps its 待办ID with 状态=已完成 and an audit note in 备注 (date, reason, previous 生成ID); affected rows get 今日行动/今日行动说明/当前阻碍/阻塞待办ID re-derived by the report prompts, never just the ID removed; every other field -- 报告日期, quote snapshot, 购买计划模式, 模式纪元, 暂停载体行数, 周计划 snapshots and 已核验暂停记录ID -- is carried over unchanged. The old generation stays as history. A writer that cannot complete the whole revision leaves the todo open.

跟进类型 only classifies presentation grouping -- it must never be used to infer or imply investment meaning (e.g. it is not a buy/sell signal, urgency score, or thesis judgment). That judgment, if any, belongs in 待办/备注's own text, per the Book/Prompt Suite's existing boundaries.

rules: Installer-owned -- users should not hand-edit this tab. Exactly one data row per installation.

This tab's field set is a lossless, mechanical flattening of installation-state.json (see that file's own flattening_convention) -- every field there has a counterpart here, and the only field here without one (last_verified_at) is documented as installer bookkeeping. A future change to installation-state.json's model must update this tab's fields to match, not just a hand-picked subset of them.

daily_task_name/weekly_task_name are the exact, deterministic identifiers an installer rerun must match against on upgrade -- never fuzzy/substring name matching over the platform's Task list. If a recorded name/id can't be found, the installer must stop for explicit user confirmation rather than auto-creating a replacement Task.

A rerun where the Sheet was read successfully and this tab is conclusively absent may treat the installation as a pre-_安装状态 legacy install and enter the bootstrap path. A rerun where the Sheet or this tab could not be read at all (permission/API error, timeout) must Block with no schema or Task mutation -- it must never be treated the same as a confirmed-absent tab.

Under schema_version 1, report_table_names_* must always equal the canonical defaults (报告摘要/报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办) -- no consumer (Task templates, GAS Dashboard) reads a custom value yet. An installer must reject a user's request to rename these tabs rather than writing a non-default value that no reader/writer actually honors.

Purchase-plan mode guard (Issue #318, #316 P1): every Daily/Weekly Task reads schema_version/purchase_plan_mode/purchase_plan_mode_epoch once at the start of each generation and uses that one result for the whole generation. A Task writes a Blocked report -- never guessed or mixed behavior -- when this tab cannot be read, when schema_version >= 9 and the mode or epoch is missing/malformed, when a schema_version <= 8 row carries a non-blank mode other than legacy, or when the mode is one the Task does not declare in its purchase_plan_modes_supported line (P1 Tasks declare legacy only). Tasks never write this tab.

external_fair_value.status: Protocol and snapshot schema (Issue #344, #342 P1); Daily/Weekly read-only selection and generation snapshot writes behind the switch (Issue #346, #342 P2, see generation below). The installer never reads or writes these tabs. The Dashboard (Issue #348, #342 P3) displays a published generation from its 报告摘要.备注 batch line and its own 外部公允价值快照 rows only (generation.reader), never reads 外部公允价值记录 or the switch, and writes nothing. The covered-subset portfolio aggregate (Issue #352, #342 P5, see portfolio_aggregate below) sits behind its own switch on top of a written generation snapshot. Merging enables nothing: with the switch blank every report is exactly what it was.
external_fair_value.description: Optional, off-by-default external fair value reference. An independent collector outside IOS appends source-neutral records to 外部公允价值记录 (Layer 1); a report generation that has the source enabled reads that tab once at its cut-off and freezes what it selected into its own 外部公允价值快照 rows (Layer 2). IOS never writes Layer 1, never logs in to or requests a source, and never triggers, waits for or retries a collection. The external value is a third-party reference shown beside the IOS fields; it never feeds 合理价值区间, 长期买入上限, 周度购买计划, 今日行动 or any gate.
external_fair_value.versioning: Not part of the schema_version sequence: schema_version stays 10 and no existing tab gains or loses a column for this module, except the optional, blank-by-default _安装状态.external_fair_value_source_id switch (and, for portfolio_aggregate, _安装状态.external_fair_value_report_currency). Neither tab below is in the tabs list, so the installer never creates them, the Dashboard's required headers never include them, and a Sheet with or without them is equally valid. Bumping schema_version was rejected because the current Daily/Weekly Tasks write the #327 price-reference columns only when schema_version is exactly 10. Layer 1 records carry their own 协议版本; Layer 2 snapshot columns are append-only.

enablement.switch: _安装状态.external_fair_value_source_id. The module is enabled exactly when this cell holds a valid source id (lower-case ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit). A missing column or a blank cell means not enabled: no Layer 1 read, no request, no login, no snapshot row, no field, todo or information-quality gap, and the report is exactly what it is today. A non-blank value that is not a valid id is a configuration error confined to the module: in a generation (Issue #346) it is a generation key fault: nothing is read or staged and the batch is 未写入 with 原因 快照键无效 (说明 generation：来源标识 invalid), with or without applicable holdings, never 已写入; the main report is unaffected. The P1 status table's 消费读取失败 for an invalid value applies only to a direct consumer read outside a generation.
enablement.who_writes_it: Only the user, at the production enablement step after the collector gate and V8 (docs/external-fair-value-source-validation.md, 'Gates'). The installer creates the column blank on a fresh install or appends it blank on a rerun, never writes a value into it, never asks about it and never creates the two tabs below.
enablement.enable: The user creates 外部公允价值记录 with the canonical header (or lets the collector create it) and 外部公允价值快照 with the canonical header, then writes the source id. Order does not matter for safety: with the switch blank nothing reads the tabs; with the switch set and a tab missing the module degrades locally (消费读取失败) and the report still publishes.
enablement.disable_and_rollback: Clear the cell (or remove the column): the next generation reads nothing and writes no snapshot row. Both tabs and every published snapshot row stay where they are, so a published generation keeps displaying exactly what it showed. Removing 外部公允价值记录 is safe at any time. Removing 外部公允价值快照 deletes the history it holds and is the user's explicit choice, never part of an installer upgrade or cleanup.
enablement.upgrade: Purely additive and idempotent: an installer rerun on any schema_version appends the blank external_fair_value_source_id column to _安装状态 when it is missing, skips it when present and never changes its value. No schema_version write, no Task update, no tab creation and no row backfill belong to this module. Interrupting it leaves either no column or a blank column, both of which mean not enabled.

external_fair_value.identity: A holding is matched to records by the listing (当前持仓.代码, 当前持仓.市场, 当前持仓.币种) against (代码, 上市市场, 报价币种). All three are compared after NFKC, trimming and upper-casing; nothing else is normalised (no exchange or currency alias table), so a collector writes 上市市场 in the ledger's own 当前持仓.市场 vocabulary. An ADR and its local share are different listings. FUND-SLEEVE rows, funds and cash get no snapshot row.

generation.order: Both Tasks, behind the switch, in the same report_write_protocol run as the other report rows: read the switch from the one _安装状态 row the mode guard already read -> freeze 读取截止时间 (an aware time in the Task's IANA zone, taken immediately before the read) -> read 外部公允价值记录 once -> select and build -> check every row (a failing row is published as 快照校验失败 with only the nine keys) -> stage by append only -> verify the whole batch -> switch 报告摘要 with the batch line in 备注 -> confirm. A new 生成ID (any retry) is a new generation with its own cut-off and its own single read; a generation never reads Layer 1 twice and never reuses another generation's rows.
generation.holdings: 当前持仓 rows with 状态=持有 and 持有数量 > 0, FUND-SLEEVE excluded, one row per listing (代码, 市场, 币种) even when held in two accounts. Engine v2 additionally snapshots the watchlist candidates actually present in this generation’s 报告持仓 (Daily priority candidates, Weekly reported candidates). The watchlist fixes the unique market and the planned asset row fixes the explicit quote currency; missing or ambiguous identity rejects the module. Deduplicate with held listings. Funds and cash get no row. A listing with a blank 代码, 市场 or 币种 is a generation key fault: the whole batch is 未写入 (快照键无效), never published without that holding or with an invented identity.
generation.batch_verify: Read back the generation's rows by (报告ID, 生成ID): rows sharing (报告ID, 生成ID, 代码, 上市市场, 报价币种) with every field equal count once (a repeated append is idempotent); the same key with any field different is a conflict; the set of listings and every row must equal the plan. The snapshot tab is usable only when every snapshot field is in its header exactly once (found by name; unknown extra columns stay blank).
generation.batch_line: While the switch is on, the 报告摘要 row the Switch step writes carries exactly one line in 备注: 外部公允价值快照批次： followed by canonical JSON with keys in this order and no spaces: 批次状态 (已写入 or 未写入), 来源标识 (the switch value as read), 读取截止时间 (as in the snapshot rows), 快照行数 (the planned row count, 0 with no applicable holding), and for 未写入 only two last keys, 原因 then a non-empty 说明; 原因 is one of 快照键无效 (generation key fault, nothing read or staged: a missing or ill-typed 报告ID/生成ID/报告类型/报告日期, an invalid 来源标识, a 读取截止时间 without a zone, a blank holding 代码/市场/币种, or two holdings that are one listing after NFKC; 说明 lists every fault, separated by ；, as generation：<key> <fault> or <代码>/<市场>/<币种>：<field> missing or …：duplicate listing <listing>, a blank part written （空）, e.g. SYNA/（空）/USD：上市市场 missing), 快照表不可用 (外部公允价值快照 missing, unreadable, or a snapshot field missing or repeated in its header), 快照写入失败 (append failed or the tool cannot append atomically), 快照校验未通过 (the read-back batch differs from the plan or holds a conflict). 已写入 only after the whole batch verified. The batch line is the first line of 备注 and every other character of 备注 (blank lines, edge whitespace, line breaks) is kept verbatim after it; there is never more than one batch line: a batch line describes only its own generation, so one carried over in reused text (a retry or a republish of the same 报告ID) is removed before this generation's line is written, and with the switch off it is removed and nothing is added. The writer removes every whole line that starts with the prefix after leading blanks (with its own line break) and nothing else; the reader is stricter and trusts only a line that starts with the prefix at column 0 and whose JSON is byte-identical to the canonical serialization (key order, no spaces, no \u escapes, no extra key), and treats leading or trailing blanks, spaces, reordered or extra keys, escapes or a second batch-like line as an invalid marker. With the switch off no batch line is written, so a missing line means not enabled (or a row written before #346) and never an enabled generation whose batch is missing.
generation.local_degradation: No module outcome (records tab missing or unreadable, wrong header, anomalous or unsupported records, read failures, not covered, 快照校验失败, a 未写入 batch, a failed batch confirmation) changes whether the report publishes, its 核心状态, 今日行动, execution fields, 报告风险, 报告待办 or any gate, and none adds a todo or an information gap. A failed batch confirmation after the switch is a module-local needs-attention (run status 外部公允价值快照确认未通过); the success notification is still sent. When the other report rows fail verification the generation does not switch and its snapshot rows are orphans like its other staged rows. After the switch nothing appends to, rewrites or deletes that 生成ID's snapshot rows; recovery is the next generation.
generation.reader: A published generation's external fair value comes only from its own batch line and its own (报告ID, 生成ID) snapshot rows. No batch line: nothing shown. 未写入: one line naming the reason and 说明, and any rows under that 生成ID are not used. 已写入 with the snapshot tab unreadable, a conflicting key, a row count other than 快照行数, an invalid row key, or a row whose 报告类型, 报告日期, 来源标识 or 读取截止时间 differs from the 报告摘要 row and the batch line: 批次不完整, nothing used. More than one batch line, or one that is not canonical: 批次标记无效, nothing used. Display never reads 外部公允价值记录, the current switch or a later protocol interpretation.
generation.task_marker: external_fair_value_snapshot: issue-346-v1 -- both Tasks carry it in their 外部公允价值快照 section; the installer reads it back and reports Task 未同步 when missing, without gating any schema step.

freshness.notes: Proposed defaults for maintainer review (Open item 3 of the contract). 采集新鲜度 is 新 when the value record's 获取时间 is at most record_threshold_days before the generation's 读取截止时间, else 过期. 模型新鲜度 is 新 when 模型数据截至日 is at most model_threshold_days before the 读取截止时间's calendar date, 过期 when older, and 未提供 when 模型数据截至日 is blank. Both are evaluated once at generation time and frozen in the snapshot; a later threshold change never relabels a published snapshot.

portfolio_aggregate.status: Daily/Weekly compute and freeze it behind its own switch; the Dashboard (same issue) displays it only after replaying it. Informational only: never an IOS valuation model or an action engine.
portfolio_aggregate.enablement: _安装状态.external_fair_value_report_currency, read from the one _安装状态 row the mode guard already read. Enabled exactly when it is non-blank and external_fair_value_source_id is enabled; a missing column, a blank cell or the fair value module off means no aggregation work, no FX request and no batch line (one carried over in reused text is removed), so the report is exactly what it is without P5. A non-blank value that is not three upper-case ASCII letters is 未写入 with 原因 组合键无效. Only the user writes it; the installer creates or appends the column blank after external_materials_source_id and never writes or asks about it.
portfolio_aggregate.inputs: Only this generation's own evidence: (1) its #346 snapshot rows as read back by (报告ID, 生成ID) after the batch verified -- the batch must be 已写入, else 未写入 with 原因 公允价值批次未写入 and 说明 the #346 reason; one in-scope listing per row, in listing order; (2) the 当前持仓 rows it already read (状态=持有 rows of the listing summed across 账户; the same 账户 twice is 持仓重复; any quantity that is not a non-negative plain decimal, thousands optionally grouped with ',', is 持仓数量异常); (3) one quote per listing from its own data step, {代码, 上市市场, 报价币种, 市场价格, 价格时间}, which must equal the generation's non-blank 报告持仓.当前价格 for that 代码 (same 报价币种); (4) FX records from its own data step, {基础币种, 计价币种, 汇率, 汇率时间}, meaning 1 基础币种 = 汇率 计价币种, only listing currency -> report currency is ever used and never inverted. 价格时间/汇率时间 are ISO 8601 with a zone or a YYYY-MM-DD trading date as the data source states them, never invented; later than the #346 读取截止时间 or unparseable is an anomaly, older than price_threshold_days/fx_threshold_days (7) is stale (a maximum acceptable age for an informational comparison, never a claim of real-time or tradable prices). A date is compared with the cut-off's calendar day and proves no time of day, so display never claims the quote or rate is from the same moment or real time. Evidence that is not a list of objects with scalar values is 未写入 with 原因 证据不可读. Never 外部公允价值记录, a second snapshot read, another generation, a login or a source request.
portfolio_aggregate.items: One per #346 row, first applicable reason wins. 市值不可计算 (excluded from the denominator): 持仓数量异常, 持仓重复, 价格缺失, 价格币种不符, 价格冲突, 价格异常, 价格过期, 汇率缺失, 汇率方向错误, 汇率冲突, 汇率异常, 汇率过期, 市值越界. Otherwise 未覆盖: 公允价值未采用 (记录状态 is not 已读取 -- the two warning 已读取 statuses are not adopted either), 公允价值采集过期, 公允价值模型过期 (过期; 未提供 is accepted), 公允价值越界; else 已覆盖. Identical duplicate evidence counts once; differing duplicates are a conflict and never resolved by order. Listing identity is (代码, 上市市场, 报价币种) after NFKC, trimming and upper-casing: an ADR and its local share never map onto each other.
portfolio_aggregate.arithmetic: Exact. 市值 = 持有数量 x 市场价格 x 汇率 and 折算外部公允价值 = 持有数量 x 外部公允价值 x 汇率, frozen per item unrounded. Totals are summed exactly and rounded once, at the end, half to even: amounts to 2 decimals, ratios to 4. Ratios are frozen as raw decimal fractions (0.1229 means 12.29%); display converts them to percent without changing the frozen value. Display precision is not a currency's trading unit and nothing is recomputed to one. 范围市值 = sum of calculable 市值; 覆盖市值 and 覆盖外部公允价值 over 已覆盖 items; 覆盖差额 = 覆盖外部公允价值 - 覆盖市值; 覆盖差额比例 = 覆盖差额 / 覆盖市值; 市值覆盖率 = 覆盖市值 / 范围市值; 未覆盖市值 = 范围市值 - 覆盖市值. With no covered item 覆盖市值, 覆盖外部公允价值, 覆盖差额 and 覆盖差额比例 are null, never 0; with no calculable item every amount and ratio is null. Any item value reaching 10^15 is 市值越界/公允价值越界; a total reaching it is 未写入 with 原因 合计越界. Cash, funds (FUND-SLEEVE), watchlist rows and 状态=持有 rows whose 持有数量 is not a positive quantity (same grammar as above) are outside the scope and only disclosed (基金行数, 非正数量行数); nothing is ever assigned a fair value of zero.
portfolio_aggregate.batch_line: The 报告摘要 row the Switch step writes carries exactly one line in 备注, directly after the #346 and #350 batch lines (or first): 外部公允价值组合批次： followed by canonical JSON, no spaces, keys in order. 已写入: 批次状态, 计算版本 (1), 报告币种, 来源标识 and 读取截止时间 (both equal to the #346 line), 范围证券数, 市值可计算证券数, 覆盖证券数 (integers), 覆盖范围 (全部覆盖/部分覆盖/无覆盖), 范围市值, 覆盖市值, 覆盖外部公允价值, 覆盖差额, 覆盖差额比例, 市值覆盖率, 未覆盖市值 (fixed decimal text or null), 基金行数, 非正数量行数, 汇率 (the FX records used, by 基础币种) and 明细 (per item: 代码, 上市市场, 报价币种, 记录状态, 引用值记录ID, 外部公允价值, 采集新鲜度, 模型新鲜度 copied from its #346 row, then 结果, 原因, 持有数量, 市场价格, 价格时间, 汇率, 市值, 折算外部公允价值; exact decimal text or null) and 证据, the raw inputs every result, reason and count rests on: 持仓 (every 状态=持有 当前持仓 row as {代码, 市场, 币种, 账户, 持有数量}, duplicates kept), 行情 (the quotes of the in-scope (代码, 上市市场) pairs), 报告持仓价格 (non-blank holding 报告持仓 {代码, 报价币种, 当前价格} of in-scope codes) and 汇率证据 (FX records in either direction between an in-scope listing currency and the report currency); each list is trimmed text sorted by code point, identical quotes, prices and FX records kept once. 未写入: 批次状态, 计算版本, 报告币种, 来源标识, 读取截止时间, 原因 (组合键无效, 公允价值批次未写入, 证据不可读, 合计越界, 批次过长 -- the first that applies) and a non-empty 说明. A line longer than max_line_chars Unicode code points (the prefix included; a supplementary-plane character counts once) is 未写入 with 原因 批次过长. The switch write is the only write, so the line is as atomic as the report itself.
portfolio_aggregate.reader: Only one line, at column 0, at most max_line_chars code points, byte-identical to its canonical form, is trusted (else 批次标记无效). 未写入 shows its reason. 已写入 is shown only when the same row's #346 batch line is 已写入 with the same 来源标识 and 读取截止时间, that generation's snapshot rows read as 已写入, every 明细 item copies its row, the 证据 holdings give exactly the batch's listings (each has a 持仓 row; every non-fund row with a positive quantity is one of them), and building the body again from 证据 alone -- every result, reason, count and total re-derived, none taken from the body -- gives the same bytes; anything else is 批次不一致 and nothing is shown. Display always names the covered subset (仅覆盖部分，不是组合整体公允价值; 范围内全部证券 at full coverage), the covered count and market-value coverage, 不含现金、基金与观察名单, the source id and the third-party note; it never calls the result the portfolio's fair value. When covered items have 模型新鲜度 未提供 it says how many (其中 N 只模型日期未提供（模型新鲜度未知）), and each such covered item's line adds 模型日期未提供，模型新鲜度未知 (never an uncovered or no-value item, which is not in the totals), so a computable total is never read as a verified-fresh valuation; both are derived from the replayed 明细, never from a stored flag. Later holdings, quotes, FX, records, switches or generations never change a published generation.
portfolio_aggregate.local_degradation: No outcome changes publication, 核心状态, 合理价值区间, 长期买入上限, 周度购买计划, 今日行动, execution fields, orders or approvals, 报告风险, 报告待办 or any gate, and none adds a todo or a gap. A failed confirmation is the module-local needs-attention 外部公允价值组合确认未通过. Daily and Weekly compute from their own evidence and never read each other's line.
portfolio_aggregate.version_2_scope: 只按冻结的正数量非基金持仓筛选组合快照；本期观察候选只作逐证券展示，不进入组合分母、覆盖率或合计。版本1维持历史整批复算规则。
portfolio_aggregate.task_marker: external_fair_value_portfolio: issue-352-v1 -- both Tasks carry it in their 外部公允价值组合对照 section; the installer reads it back and reports Task 未同步 when missing, without gating any schema step.

rules: Envelope: 记录ID, 协议版本, 来源标识, 代码, 上市市场, 报价币种, 获取时间 and 记录完整 keep their names and meaning in every protocol version, so IOS can order and match a record whose other fields it does not understand. A new 协议版本 may change only the other fields.

Columns are found by header name after trimming. The tab is unusable (消费读取失败 for every holding) when it is missing, cannot be read, lacks any envelope column, or has any field of this tab as a column header more than once; an empty but readable tab is not a failure. Column order does not matter, unknown extra columns are ignored (they still count when comparing duplicate 记录ID rows), and a missing non-envelope column reads as empty.

Cut-off: a row whose envelope 获取时间 is later than the generation's 读取截止时间, or a supported-version 手工导入 row whose 导入时间 is, takes no part in that generation at all (it can neither be selected nor make a listing 记录异常 or 币种或证券不匹配). A row whose 获取时间 equals the cut-off, in any time zone, takes part. The body of an unsupported 协议版本 (获取方式, 导入时间 and every other non-envelope field) is never read, so it cannot change selection, order or status. Candidates are rows with 记录完整=是, the configured 来源标识 and not after the cut-off. A candidate is malformed when 记录ID or 协议版本 is empty, 代码/上市市场/报价币种 is empty, 获取时间 is not ISO 8601 with a time zone, or (for a supported 协议版本) any version 1 field rule on this tab fails or 模型数据截至日 is later than the 读取截止时间's calendar day. A malformed candidate that names a full listing gives that listing 记录异常; otherwise it is ignored.

Version 1 field rules: 来源名称, 采集结果 and 获取方式 are required; 成功 requires a positive 外部公允价值 and leaves 失败说明 empty; 读取失败/未覆盖 leave 外部公允价值, 外部区间下沿, 外部区间上沿, 模型数据截至日, 页面价格 and 页面价格时间 empty; numbers are plain decimals (no sign, exponent, thousands separator or leading zero, at most 15 integer and 8 fractional digits) compared exactly, never as binary floats; the range bounds and the page price/time are pairs; 外部区间下沿 is not above 外部区间上沿; 模型数据截至日 is empty or YYYY-MM-DD and not after the calendar day of the record's own 获取时间; 页面价格时间 is not after 获取时间; 手工导入 requires 导入时间 not before 获取时间 and 自动采集 leaves it empty.
No credentials, cookies, session state, account identity or collector environment details belong in any field.

Every display of a generation, including history, is built from these rows alone; nothing reads Layer 1, the current switch or a later protocol interpretation to display a published generation. A separate tab rather than 报告持仓 columns, so enabling or disabling the module never changes a report tab header.
