rules: Status table (first applicable row wins; exactly one applies): 1 tab unusable or switch value invalid -> 消费读取失败; 2 a malformed or conflicting candidate names this listing -> 记录异常; 3 no record for this listing but a candidate has the same 代码 with another market or currency -> 币种或证券不匹配; 4 no record -> 无记录; 5 latest attempt of an unsupported 协议版本 with a value record -> 已读取，最新记录版本不支持; 6 latest attempt of an unsupported 协议版本 without one -> 协议版本不支持; 7 latest attempt 成功 -> 已读取; 8 latest attempt 读取失败 with a value record -> 已读取，最近一次采集失败; 9 latest attempt 读取失败 without one -> 读取失败; 10 latest attempt 未覆盖 -> 未覆盖, even when an earlier value record exists.

Order: a listing's records (malformed and conflicting rows excluded, identical duplicates counted once) are ordered by 获取时间, then by 记录ID compared as a string. The latest attempt is the last one whatever its 协议版本; the value record is the last one with a supported 协议版本 and 采集结果=成功. Selection is a pure function of the rows read: any row order gives the same result.

Value group: 引用值记录ID, 引用值协议版本, 来源名称, 外部公允价值, 值记录获取时间, 获取方式, 采集新鲜度 and 模型新鲜度 are all set exactly in statuses 已读取, 已读取，最近一次采集失败 and 已读取，最新记录版本不支持, with 引用值协议版本 supported; otherwise they and the optional members (外部区间下沿, 外部区间上沿, 模型数据截至日, 来源链接, 页面价格, 页面价格时间) are all empty.
Latest-attempt group: 引用最近尝试记录ID, 引用最近尝试协议版本 and 最近尝试获取时间 are all set exactly in status rows 5-10 and all empty in rows 1-4; 引用最近尝试协议版本 is unsupported in rows 5-6 and supported in rows 7-10.

Agreement: 最近尝试采集结果 is 成功 in row 7 (where 引用值记录ID equals 引用最近尝试记录ID), 读取失败 in rows 8-9 (row 8 citing a different value record), 未覆盖 in row 10 and empty in rows 1-6; 最近尝试失败说明 is empty outside rows 8-10.

Types: before publishing, every set field is checked against its type and enum here and against the Layer 1 rules (positive plain decimals compared exactly, range and page price pairs, ISO 8601 times with a zone, YYYY-MM-DD dates); 来源标识 is a valid source id except on a 消费读取失败 row; 值记录获取时间, 最近尝试获取时间 and 页面价格时间 are not after 读取截止时间 and 模型数据截至日 is not after its calendar day; 最近尝试获取时间 is not before 值记录获取时间 and 页面价格时间 not after it; 采集新鲜度 and 模型新鲜度 equal what the thresholds give for 值记录获取时间 and 模型数据截至日 at 读取截止时间. The nine keys come from the generation, never from a record: a row with a missing or ill-typed key is a generation fault and is not staged at all.

A row that fails any check above is never published as selected: it is stored as 记录状态=快照校验失败 with only the nine key fields (报告ID to 读取截止时间) set and every other field empty. The main report is unaffected.

One row per holding of the generation (资产类型=holding, excluding FUND-SLEEVE), written under the generation's own (报告ID, 生成ID) while the switch is on. With the switch off no row is written. Rows are append-only and are never deleted by report cleanup; a superseded generation's rows are inert by the read contract.

Never a value, todo, gap or status in any other tab: 记录状态 of any value leaves the report's 核心状态, 今日行动, 周度购买计划 and every gate unchanged. The one exception is the generation-level batch line in 报告摘要.备注 (Issue #346, see generation.batch_line), which records only whether this generation's batch was written.

external_financial_materials.status: Protocol, snapshot schema and Daily/Weekly consumption behind the switch (Issue #350, #342 P4). The installer never reads or writes these tabs. No Dashboard change: published snapshots are evidence for history and a later reviewable Dashboard package. Merging enables nothing: with the switch blank every report is exactly what it was.
external_financial_materials.description: Optional, off-by-default third-party financial materials. An independent collector outside IOS appends normalised, source-neutral records to 外部财经材料记录 (Layer 1); a Daily or Weekly generation with the source enabled reads that tab once, before its research, binds records to its own scope, de-duplicates them and freezes what it adopted, rejected or could not read into its own 外部财经材料快照 rows (Layer 2), with research's fact/opinion and primary-source verification fields. A separate protocol from external_fair_value. IOS never writes Layer 1, never logs in to or requests a source, and never triggers, waits for or retries a collection. A material is research context only: it never directly changes a valuation field, 长期买入上限, 周度购买计划, 今日行动, an execution field, an approval or ordering gate, or whether a report is valid.
external_financial_materials.versioning: Not part of the schema_version sequence: schema_version stays 10 (the #327 price-reference writes depend on exactly 10) and no existing tab gains or loses a column, except the optional, blank-by-default _安装状态.external_materials_source_id switch. Neither tab below is in the tabs list, so the installer never creates them and the Dashboard's required headers never include them. Layer 1 records carry their own 协议版本; Layer 2 snapshot columns are append-only.

enablement.switch: _安装状态.external_materials_source_id, independent of external_fair_value_source_id. The module is enabled exactly when this cell holds a valid source id (lower-case ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit). A missing column or a blank cell means not enabled: no Layer 1 read, no request, no login prompt, no snapshot row, no todo and no information-quality gap, and the report is exactly what it is today. A non-blank invalid value is a generation key fault: nothing is read or staged and the batch is 未写入 (快照键无效, 说明 generation：来源标识 invalid); the main report is unaffected.
enablement.who_writes_it: Only the user, at a production enablement step. The installer creates the column blank on a fresh install or appends it blank on a rerun, never writes a value into it, never asks about it and never creates the two tabs below.
enablement.disable_and_rollback: Clear the cell (or remove the column): the next generation reads nothing and writes no snapshot row or batch line. Every published snapshot row stays, so a published generation keeps its evidence. Removing 外部财经材料记录 is safe at any time; removing 外部财经材料快照 deletes history and is only the user's explicit choice.
enablement.upgrade: Purely additive and idempotent: an installer rerun on any schema_version appends the blank external_materials_source_id column to _安装状态 after external_fair_value_source_id when it is missing, skips it when present and never changes its value. No schema_version write, no tab creation and no backfill.

external_financial_materials.identity: A record names one listing (代码, 上市市场), compared with the generation's scope listings (代码, 市场) after NFKC, trimming and upper-casing; currency is not part of a material's identity and no alias table is used, so an ADR and its local share are different listings. A record whose 代码 equals a scope listing's 代码 but whose 上市市场 differs or is blank is never bound: it gives that scope listing one 证券不匹配 row. A record that names no scope listing at all is counted in 范围外记录数. Links are compared in canonical form: lower-case scheme and host, default port, fragment and tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid) dropped, remaining query parameters sorted as written, an empty path '/', a trailing '/' dropped; nothing else (no scheme or www folding).
selection: Read: the tab is unusable (消费状态 消费读取失败, no row) when it is missing, cannot be read (not a readable grid: header or rows missing, null or not a list, a header cell that is not text, a row that is not a list of cells, a cell that is not a single scalar value, or a non-blank cell beyond the last header column), lacks an envelope column or has any field of this tab as a header more than once. A malformed tab is always this failure, never an error that escapes the module. Columns are found by header name in any order; unknown extra columns are ignored except that they take part in duplicate-ID comparison. A readable empty tab is 已读取 with no row.

Candidates: rows with 记录完整=是 and the configured 来源标识 whose envelope 获取时间 is not after 读取截止时间 (and, for a supported-version 手工导入, whose 导入时间 is not after it); a row exactly at the cut-off in any zone takes part. Rows after the cut-off are invisible to the generation.

Units: candidates sharing a 记录ID are one unit when every cell is equal (idempotent) and a 记录冲突 for every listing they name otherwise; a complete row without 记录ID is its own unit keyed by a content fingerprint (identical copies collapse).

Per bound unit, first match: 记录异常 (empty 记录ID/协议版本/代码/上市市场, unparsable 获取时间, or a supported version failing the version 1 field rules), 版本不支持 (any other unsupported 协议版本; its body is never read, so it cannot replace, hide or impersonate another record), 采集失败 (a failed attempt, kept beside earlier materials, never replacing them), otherwise a supported success that joins material de-duplication.

Window: a success counts by 发布时间, every other unit by 获取时间, against 窗口开始时间; a unit or material class entirely before the window is counted in 窗口外记录数 instead of getting a row; a time that does not parse never hides a unit.

Material de-duplication per listing: successes are joined (transitively) when their canonical 材料链接 are equal or, with 原始发布方 set, their normalised (原始发布方, 标题) and 发布时间 instant are equal. A class whose members agree on normalised 标题, 发布时间 instant, 事件时间 and normalised 原始发布方 is one 已采用 row citing every member in 相关记录ID and showing its representative (earliest 获取时间, then 记录ID); a class that disagrees on any of them is one 记录冲突 row naming the fields, and none of its records is used. De-duplication never crosses listings.
Selection is a pure function of the rows read, the scope, 读取截止时间 and 窗口开始时间: row order, repeated rows and replays never change it. Rows are ordered by listing then 材料键.

generation.order: Both Tasks, behind the switch: read the switch from the _安装状态 row the mode guard already read -> check generation keys -> freeze 读取截止时间 (an aware time in the Task's IANA zone) and take 窗口开始时间 from the generation's own research window -> read 外部财经材料记录 once, before research (第二步) -> select -> research annotates each 已采用 row -> finalize every row -> stage by append in the same report_write_protocol run -> verify the whole batch by (报告ID, 生成ID) -> switch 报告摘要 with the batch line in 备注 -> confirm. A new 生成ID (any retry) is a new generation with its own cut-off and its own single read.
generation.scope: 当前持仓 rows with 状态=持有 and 持有数量 > 0 (FUND-SLEEVE excluded) plus 观察名单 rows: daily takes 优先级=高 (or the legacy high), weekly takes every row -- the same rows the report covers -- one per listing (代码, 市场). A scope row with a blank 代码 or 市场 is a generation key fault (说明 <代码>/<市场>：<field> missing, a blank part written （空）).
generation.research: Research may cite external materials only through this generation's 已采用 rows and only in the attributed form of that row: 来源名称 (and 原始发布方), 标题, the listing, 发布时间, 事件时间 or 事件时间未提供, 获取时间, 内容性质, 核实状态 (with 一手来源链接) and 研究归类. A third-party assertion stays 第三方说法 until a primary source confirms it; only 已核实 material with 一手来源链接 is a 事实; 与一手来源矛盾 follows the primary source; 观点 is never upgraded. Material facts that affect a conclusion are checked against an available primary source through the existing research path; IOS never logs in to the third-party source to do so. A material may shape 关键变化, 下一验证点, 报告风险 or a research 报告待办 through the existing reasoning and evidence rules, never directly a valuation field, 长期买入上限, 周度购买计划, 今日行动, an execution field or any gate. Research annotates this generation's 已采用 rows only: an annotation whose (代码, 上市市场, 材料键) names any other planned row (记录冲突, 记录异常, 版本不支持, 采集失败, 证券不匹配) or no planned row at all (an unknown key, a record out of scope or out of the window, another listing, a de-duplicated non-representative key) is 引用越界 -- the whole batch is 未写入, nothing is staged, no row is annotated, and 说明 names each such 代码/上市市场：材料键 (with the planned status when there is one). The existing news and research sources remain the normal input; no external material is required.
generation.batch_verify: Read back the generation's rows by (报告ID, 生成ID): rows sharing (报告ID, 生成ID, 代码, 上市市场, 材料键) with every field equal count once; the same key with any difference is a conflict; the set of keys and every row must equal the plan. The snapshot tab is usable only when it is a readable grid in the same sense as 外部财经材料记录 and every snapshot field is in its header exactly once; otherwise the batch is 未写入 (快照表不可用) and nothing is appended.
generation.batch_line: While the switch is on, the 报告摘要 row the Switch step writes carries exactly one line 外部财经材料批次： followed by canonical JSON with keys in this order and no spaces: 批次状态 (已写入 or 未写入), 来源标识, 读取截止时间, 窗口开始时间, 消费状态 (已读取, 消费读取失败, or 未读取 only for 快照键无效), 范围证券数, 快照行数, 范围外记录数, 窗口外记录数, and for 未写入 only two last keys, 原因 then a non-empty 说明; 原因 is one of 快照键无效 (generation key fault, nothing read or staged), 快照表不可用, 快照写入失败, 快照校验未通过 (read-back differs from the plan or holds a conflict) or 引用越界 (research annotated or cited anything other than this generation's own 已采用 rows; 说明 names each key). When several apply, the first in this order is recorded: 快照键无效, 快照表不可用, 引用越界, 快照写入失败, 快照校验未通过 (a 引用越界 batch attempts no append). Empty input is 已写入 with 消费状态 已读取 and 0 rows; an unusable records tab is 已写入 with 消费状态 消费读取失败 and 0 rows. The line sits directly after the external fair value batch line (#346) when that line is the first line of 备注, otherwise first; every other character of 备注 is kept verbatim, a carried-over materials line is replaced, and with the switch off it is removed and nothing is added. The reader trusts only a column-0 line whose JSON is byte-identical to the canonical serialization.
generation.local_degradation: No module outcome (tab unusable, anomalous, conflicting, unsupported or failed records, 快照校验失败, a 未写入 batch, a failed confirmation) changes whether the report publishes, its 核心状态, 今日行动, execution fields, 报告风险, 报告待办 or any gate, and none adds a todo or an information gap. A failed confirmation is a module-local needs-attention (外部财经材料快照确认未通过); the success notification is still sent. Daily and Weekly read back only their own (报告ID, 生成ID), so neither can repair, back or contaminate the other.
generation.reader: A published generation's materials come only from its own batch line and its own rows. No batch line: not enabled (or before #350). 未写入: one line with 原因 and 说明, rows not used. 已写入 with an unreadable tab, a conflicting key, a row count other than 快照行数, an invalid row key, a row whose 报告类型, 报告日期, 来源标识, 读取截止时间 or 窗口开始时间 differs from the summary row and the batch line, or invalid summary generation keys: 批次不完整. More than one batch line or a non-canonical one: 批次标记无效. A row failing the snapshot checks reads as 快照校验失败. Display never reads 外部财经材料记录, the current switch or another generation.
generation.task_marker: external_financial_materials: issue-350-v1 -- both Tasks carry it in their 外部财经材料 section; the installer reads it back and reports Task 未同步 when missing, without gating any schema step.

limits.notes: Confirmed by the maintainer (2026-10-24). Longer input is 记录异常, never truncated or rewritten; the limits do not replace the source terms (V8 decides where real content may be stored). The collector stores only a short excerpt or the source's own summary permitted by the source terms, never a full paid body.

外部财经材料记录.purpose: Append-only normalised financial materials written by an independent collector, one record per material per listing or per failed attempt per listing. IOS reads it and never writes, edits, sorts or deletes it.

fields.name: 记录ID
fields.notes: Unique per record, set by the collector, never reused. Rows sharing an ID with every cell equal count as one record; any difference makes every listing those rows name get one 记录冲突 row and none of them is used.

fields.name: 协议版本
fields.notes: Compared as trimmed text. IOS reads the non-envelope fields only for a version in supported_protocol_versions; any other version is 版本不支持 and its body is never read.

fields.name: 来源标识
fields.notes: Stable, source-neutral id compared with _安装状态.external_materials_source_id. Rows of another source are ignored.

fields.name: 来源名称
fields.notes: Display name of the collecting source. Version 1: required on every record.

fields.name: 代码
fields.notes: With 上市市场, the one listing this record is about. A material about two listings is two records.

fields.name: 上市市场
fields.notes: In the ledger's own 当前持仓.市场/观察名单.市场 vocabulary; no alias table.

fields.name: 采集结果
fields.notes: Version 1: required. 采集失败 is one failed attempt for this listing and carries no material field.

fields.name: 材料链接
fields.notes: Version 1, 成功: required, an absolute http(s) link with no user info, whitespace or credential-like query parameter (token, session, sid, auth, key, signature ...). Compared in canonical form (see identity).

fields.name: 标题
fields.notes: Version 1, 成功: required, at most limits.title_max_chars characters, as the source states it.

fields.name: 原始发布方
fields.notes: Optional: the original publisher when the material is syndicated. Used for syndication de-duplication only when set.

fields.name: 发布时间
fields.notes: Version 1, 成功: required, ISO 8601 with a time zone, when the source published the material; not after this record's 获取时间. Never replaced by 事件时间 or 获取时间.

fields.name: 事件时间
fields.notes: Optional: when the event the material reports happens or happened, as ISO 8601 with a zone or YYYY-MM-DD; may be later than 发布时间 (an announced event). Empty when the source states none; never filled from 发布时间 or 获取时间.

fields.name: 材料摘要
fields.notes: Version 1, 成功: required, the source's own short summary or excerpt, at most limits.summary_max_chars characters. Never a full paid article body.

fields.name: 获取时间
fields.notes: ISO 8601 with a time zone: when this attempt read the source, or for an import when the export was made.

fields.name: 获取方式
fields.notes: Version 1: required.

fields.name: 导入时间
fields.notes: 手工导入 only, not before 获取时间; empty for 自动采集.

fields.name: 失败说明
fields.notes: Version 1: required on 采集失败, empty on 成功. No credentials or session data.

fields.name: 记录完整
fields.notes: Written last. A row without exactly 是 is half-written and invisible.

rules: Envelope: 记录ID, 协议版本, 来源标识, 代码, 上市市场, 获取时间 and 记录完整 keep their names and meaning in every protocol version.

Version 1 field rules: 来源名称, 采集结果 and 获取方式 are required; 成功 requires 材料链接, 标题, 发布时间 and 材料摘要, an empty 失败说明, 发布时间 not after 获取时间, and a 事件时间 that is empty, ISO 8601 with a zone or YYYY-MM-DD; 采集失败 requires 失败说明 and leaves 材料链接, 标题, 原始发布方, 发布时间, 事件时间 and 材料摘要 empty; 手工导入 needs 导入时间 not before 获取时间 and 自动采集 leaves it empty. A supported-version record failing any rule is 记录异常 for the listing it names.
No credentials, login or session state, account identity, collector environment details or full paid article bodies belong in any field; repository fixtures are synthetic.

外部财经材料快照.purpose: Per-generation record of what one Daily or Weekly generation adopted, rejected or could not use, with research's classification, written only by that generation and keyed by (报告ID, 生成ID). Daily and Weekly keep separate rows even when they read the same records.

fields.name: 生成ID
fields.notes: Live only while it equals the 生成ID in that 报告ID's 报告摘要 row.

fields.name: 来源标识
fields.notes: The switch value this generation read.

fields.name: 读取截止时间
fields.notes: The generation's single Layer 1 read time.

fields.name: 窗口开始时间
fields.notes: Start of the generation's research window (Daily: its 研究窗口; Weekly: 周期开始 00:00 in the Task's zone); not after 读取截止时间.

fields.name: 代码
fields.notes: The scope listing as written in 当前持仓 or 观察名单.

fields.name: 材料键
fields.notes: Row identity within the generation and listing: 材料:<canonical link> for a material class (the smallest canonical link among its records), 记录:<记录ID> for a single record or an ID conflict, 指纹:<16 hex> for a complete row without 记录ID.

fields.name: 引用记录ID
fields.notes: The record whose fields this row shows (已采用: the class representative, earliest 获取时间 then 记录ID).

fields.name: 引用协议版本
fields.notes: 协议版本 of 引用记录ID's record.

fields.name: 相关记录ID
fields.notes: Every 记录ID behind this row as a sorted JSON array without spaces, e.g. ["m1","m2"].

fields.name: 标题
fields.notes: 已采用 only.

fields.name: 材料链接
fields.notes: 已采用 only, in canonical form.

fields.name: 原始发布方
fields.notes: 已采用 only, optional.

fields.name: 发布时间
fields.notes: 已采用 only, copied unchanged; within the window.

fields.name: 事件时间
fields.notes: 已采用 only, copied unchanged; empty when the record has none.

fields.name: 材料摘要
fields.notes: 已采用 only.

fields.name: 获取时间
fields.notes: 已采用, 版本不支持 and 采集失败: the cited record's 获取时间.

fields.name: 获取方式
fields.notes: 已采用 and 采集失败.

fields.name: 失败说明
fields.notes: 采集失败 only.

fields.name: 校验说明
fields.notes: 记录冲突, 记录异常 and 证券不匹配: why the record was not used.

fields.name: 研究归类
fields.notes: 已采用 only, set by the generation's research: where the material sits in the report's existing filter. 长期重要信号 needs 内容性质=事实.

fields.name: 内容性质
fields.notes: 已采用 only: 事实 exactly when 核实状态=已核实, 观点 exactly when 不适用, otherwise 第三方说法 (an attributed claim).

fields.name: 核实状态
fields.notes: 已采用 only.

fields.name: 一手来源链接
fields.notes: 已采用 only, set exactly when 核实状态 is 已核实 or 与一手来源矛盾: the primary source (company filing, release, regulator) checked, never the third-party material's own link.

fields.name: 研究说明
fields.notes: 已采用 only, required: the research impact in one line.

rules: Per status, set fields: 已采用 -- 引用记录ID, 引用协议版本 (supported), 相关记录ID, 来源名称, 标题, 材料链接 (canonical), 发布时间 (within the window, not after 获取时间), 材料摘要, 获取时间 (not after the cut-off), 获取方式 and the research fields 研究归类, 内容性质, 核实状态, 研究说明 (原始发布方, 事件时间 and 一手来源链接 optional); 记录冲突 -- 相关记录ID, 校验说明; 记录异常 and 证券不匹配 -- 校验说明 (引用记录ID, 引用协议版本 and 相关记录ID when the record has an ID); 版本不支持 -- 引用记录ID, 引用协议版本 (unsupported), 相关记录ID, 获取时间; 采集失败 -- 引用记录ID, 引用协议版本 (supported), 相关记录ID, 来源名称, 获取时间, 获取方式, 失败说明. Every other field is empty. 引用记录ID is in 相关记录ID; a 记录: key cites exactly its own ID; a 指纹: key cites none; 材料: keys belong to 已采用 and 记录冲突 only.

Research fields: 事实 exactly when 核实状态=已核实, 观点 exactly when 不适用, 第三方说法 for 未能核实 and 与一手来源矛盾; 一手来源链接 is set exactly for 已核实 and 与一手来源矛盾, is an absolute http(s) link and is not the material's own canonical link; 长期重要信号 requires 事实.
A row failing any check is published as 快照校验失败 with only the ten keys set. Keys come from the generation itself; wrong keys are a generation fault and nothing is staged.

Rows are append-only under the generation's own (报告ID, 生成ID) while the switch is on; nothing appends to, rewrites or deletes a switched 生成ID's rows. The only trace in another tab is the generation-level batch line in 报告摘要.备注.

report_write_protocol.description: How a writer commits one 报告ID's data across four tabs without a native cross-tab transaction. Full rationale in docs/v2.1-architecture.md's 'Report write protocol' section.
steps: 1. Generate: mint a fresh 生成ID for this write attempt (first attempt or retry alike); never reuse a prior attempt's 生成ID.

2. Plan: BEFORE writing any row, fix two things for each of the four sections this generation must contain once staging finishes -- 报告持仓 rows with 资产类型=holding, 报告持仓 rows with 资产类型=watchlist, 报告风险 rows, 报告待办 rows: (a) the exact set of row identities (each holding/watchlist row's 代码/名称, or an equivalent stable per-item key decided for that 报告风险/报告待办 item) this generation must contain, and (b) the count that set implies. A count alone is not a complete plan -- a stage that drops one planned item while duplicating another can preserve the count while still being wrong, so steps 4 and 6 must check identities, not merely counts. What belongs in the plan is report-type-specific, not one universal rule: 报告持仓(holding) is always the complete set of current holdings, for both Daily and Weekly; 报告持仓(watchlist) for a Weekly generation is the complete current 观察名单 (Issue #293 requires every watchlist row to receive a fresh weekly priority result every time), while for a Daily generation it is only the subset that report type's own canonical selection rule authorizes (currently 观察名单 rows with 优先级=高 -- the canonical value defined by Issue #293's weekly priority review; a legacy row still carrying the pre-#293 English high value reads as equivalent but must never be newly written -- per setup/daily-task-prompt.md) -- a Daily plan must never expand to the full watchlist, and a Weekly plan must never narrow below it; 报告风险/报告待办 items are whatever this run's own analysis decided to report, fixed here before staging, never derived afterward from whatever ends up staged.

3. Stage: write EVERY 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 row that should exist under the new generation -- not only the rows this run actually recomputed. A row carried forward unchanged from the previous generation (e.g. a holding whose thesis didn't change this run) must still be (re)written under the new (报告ID, 生成ID), because the read contract in step 7 matches by exact 生成ID: a row left tagged with the OLD 生成ID becomes invisible the moment 报告摘要 switches to the new one. A generation must never be partial -- writing some tables/rows under the new 生成ID while leaving others on a prior 生成ID reproduces the 2026-09-05 incident (a Weekly rerun that only re-staged watchlist rows under a new 生成ID left holdings/risks on the old one, so the Dashboard correctly rendered 0 holdings once 报告摘要 switched). The existing 报告摘要 row, if any, is untouched during this step -- readers still see the last known-good generation. Write mechanics (Issue #306, 2026-10-16 incident): stage only by appending new rows at the end of the table (e.g. Sheets values.append, inserting rows); never read a 'first empty row' once and then write a precomputed fixed row range, and never rewrite a row that was non-empty before. Daily and Weekly may run at the same time against the same report tabs, and precomputed row ranges let one run overwrite the other's staged rows (2026-10-16 23:31: after both ran concurrently, the published Weekly generation held 16 of its 31 planned rows while its summary still claimed 31; the row layout suggests a concurrent Daily overwrote 15 Weekly rows, which no write log has confirmed). Reading a range back as empty and then writing it is NOT safe: the read and the write are separate steps, so another writer can fill the same range in between, even after this run has verified, switched and confirmed. A run whose write tool cannot do a server-side atomic append (inserting new rows) must stage nothing: stop before step 3, leave 报告摘要 on the prior 生成ID, and report 'Blocked: write tool cannot append atomically'. 报告摘要's 当前持仓数/高优先级观察数 and any item counts in 一句话结论/核心状态 come from step 4's read-back, never copied from step 2's plan.

4. Verify (pre-switch, fail-closed): read back the staged rows for (报告ID, 生成ID) and compare them against step 2's plan on BOTH axes for every section -- the count, and the exact set of row identities. An exact count match achieved by the wrong set of identities (a planned item missing, an extra/duplicate item present) is still a failure, not merely an approximate or partial one, and never a comparison against vague intent instead of the fixed plan from step 2. Stop here on any mismatch -- 报告摘要 stays untouched (it still references the prior generation, or nothing, for a first attempt) and the staged rows become orphans (step 8). A watchlist-only generation whose holdings/risks counts stayed at zero while step 2 planned nonzero holdings/risks is exactly the 2026-09-05 incident's shape, and this comparison is what must catch it before step 5 ever runs.
5. Switch: only after step 4's verification succeeds, create/update the single 报告摘要 row for 报告ID with the new 生成ID. This single-row write is the actual commit point.

6. Confirm (post-switch, fail-closed): after the switch lands, re-read 报告摘要 for this 报告ID and confirm its 生成ID now equals the value just written; re-read 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 filtered to this exact (报告ID, 生成ID) and compare them against step 2's plan again on both axes -- count and exact row identities. A run may only report success (its own run status and any user-facing notification) once this confirmation succeeds. If confirmation fails for any reason -- an unexpected 生成ID read back, any section's count or identity set off, or the re-read itself failing -- the run must surface failure/needs-attention through its own run status and must NOT send a success notification, even though 报告摘要 has already switched; this is a distinct failure class from a pre-switch (step 4) failure precisely because the publish already happened, and it needs the same visibility, not less.
7. Read contract: a reader only trusts 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 rows whose 生成ID matches the 生成ID currently in that 报告ID's 报告摘要 row.

8. Cleanup: rows from superseded/orphaned generations may be deleted at any later point (next successful run, periodic sweep) -- this is never a precondition for correctness, since step 7 already makes them inert. In three_layer/three_layer_hold (#316 P3) cleanup deletes no 报告持仓 row at all -- not only rows carrying 暂停事件载荷, because deleting any row shifts later rows under a paged read -- and no 周计划暂停记录 row.

9. Failure/retry: a run that fails before step 5 leaves 报告摘要 pointing at the last known-good 生成ID (or absent, for a first attempt); the failure is surfaced via the Task's own run status, never by a partial 报告摘要 write. A run whose step 6 confirmation fails after step 5's switch already landed must likewise surface failure via its own run status/notification, never by a second silent 报告摘要 write. Either way, a retry restarts at step 1 with a new 生成ID.

blocked_vs_empty.description: A report's 核心状态 must distinguish these -- conflating them was a Phase A review finding.
blocked_vs_empty.blocked: A required tab could not be read at all, a required column is missing, or the Sheet's schema_version is incompatible with what the Task knows how to handle.
blocked_vs_empty.valid_empty_result: A tab was read successfully and legitimately has zero matching rows (e.g. an empty 观察名单, or a user holding no current positions). This is normal portfolio state and must never be treated as Blocked or degrade the report's status.

rules: Applies to every tab, including the four 报告* tabs: a schema_version bump must not delete or rewrite existing rows by default. A historical report row is not necessarily reproducible by re-running the Task that produced it, so 报告* rows are not disposable just because they are system-generated.
A schema_version bump must never overwrite an existing user-entered cell in 当前持仓, 交易记录, or 观察名单 without explicit user approval.

The report_write_protocol's atomic replace-by-生成ID mechanism is a normal write-time operation scoped to one 报告ID's own re-run -- it is not a schema migration, and migration logic must not treat it as a general license to rewrite report history.

A genuinely destructive migration (a change no existing row can be read against additively) must be its own explicit, versioned step: back up first, provide a documented rollback, and require explicit user approval before running against a real installation -- never silently bundled into an ordinary installer upgrade.
A future breaking schema_version change must be documented with an explicit upgrade path in this file's own changelog (none yet -- this is schema_version 1).

schema_changelog.summary: Adds five order-policy columns to 入场计划 (计划新增仓位币种/计划新增仓位金额/订单类型/订单有效期/跳空处理规则, all Deep-Dive-owned), a new 入场执行反馈 tab (durable, user-authorized, append-only order-status feedback: 未下单/已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消/未知, keyed to a specific plan version and zone), and six report-snapshot columns on 报告持仓 (准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期/跳空处理提示/最近订单状态). This is Issue #303 Phase 2: order-preparation information computed by transparent mechanical lookup/arithmetic against an already-existing, traceable, human-confirmed plan -- never a new budget/threshold/entry-point decision, and never an executable buy/sell instruction. All actual order submission remains the user's own action. No existing tab's fields were removed, renamed, or reordered; every schema_version 1-5 Sheet remains fully readable as-is, and existing 报告持仓 rows without these six columns read identically to a row whose 入场计划ID is blank -- no historical row needs rewriting. This is the second and final installment of Issue #303's two-phase execution-explanation closure. PR #305 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): 准备状态 is fail-closed on missing/unknown/stale 入场执行反馈 and on an existing partial fill, scans for an existing order across a 代码's whole plan-version lineage by zone label rather than only the current active 计划ID, and runs a cash preflight against 账户状态 before confirming 可准备订单; 入场执行反馈 gained an idempotency/replay rule and a same-day tie-break rule; the Task-prompt direct instructions were corrected to match this canonical decision table exactly (they had collapsed the missing-evaluation-data case into the no-active-plan blank case). PR #305 round 3 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): added structured, machine-checkable 区间1/2/3上一版本对应区间 fields to 入场计划 so a batch-identity lookup correctly follows a zone across a plan revision that reorders it, replacing the round 2 fix's free-text 全新资金 escape hatch; added 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 manual preflight confirmation fields so trading unit, order-type support, and currency conversion feasibility are affirmatively checked (same user-authorized-fact pattern as 账户状态) before 报告持仓.准备状态 can reach 可准备订单, rather than relying on a standing disclaimer. PR #305 round 4 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): added 交易单位确认时间/订单类型可用性确认时间/换汇可行性确认时间 fields so the round 3 confirmations are checked for a freshness window, instead of a long-lived unstamped string silently authorizing a later preparation; and added a plan-level budget-reservation step to 报告持仓.准备状态's decision order (now seven steps) that aggregates reserved/consumed amounts using each live order's own historical plan-version numbers before confirming 可准备订单, so multiple zones of one plan can no longer each pass an isolated cash check while jointly exceeding the plan's own 计划新增仓位金额. PR #305 round 5 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): replaced round 4's per-field 换汇可行性确认账户 with a single shared 订单资金账户 field binding ALL three manual confirmations (not just 换汇可行性确认) to the one account that will actually fund the order, since trading-unit and order-type support can differ by account even within the same currency; fixed the freshness rule to require 0<=age<=30 days (a future-dated confirmation previously passed trivially); and generalized the budget-reservation scan from the active version's own sibling zones to the WHOLE plan lineage, so a historical zone with no successor in the active version (e.g. a dropped predecessor zone that still has a live order) is no longer silently omitted from the reserved total. PR #305 round 6 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): the cash preflight now requires the named 订单资金账户's own 账户状态.币种 to exactly match 计划新增仓位币种 (a cross-currency balance was previously compared as a raw number, which could pass a USD order against a JPY balance) and its own 数据时间 to be within a 7-day, non-future-dated freshness window (previously unchecked entirely); the budget-reservation scan now also excludes, fail-closed, any historical reservation whose own 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the active version's, since this system does no currency conversion and cannot net mismatched-currency amounts as raw numbers. PR #305 round 7 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): a later 已取消/未下单 report for a (代码,关联计划ID,对应区间) key that earlier recorded a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量 is no longer treated as 'clear' -- a cancellation of the unfilled remainder never reverses shares already bought, so this now fails closed to 无法确认 (manual reconciliation) instead of letting 报告持仓.准备状态 fall through to 可准备订单 and authorize preparing the original full tranche on top of capital already invested. PR #305 round 8 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): the round 7 fix only scanned for a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量; since 已成交数量 is optional per 入场执行反馈's own field notes (blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero'), a 部分成交/已成交 row that never recorded a quantity was wrongly treated as leaving no fill evidence, so a later 已取消/未下单 on that same key could fall through to 可准备订单 despite a real prior fill -- now a row whose own 订单状态 is 部分成交/已成交 is itself sufficient fill evidence, independent of whether 已成交数量 was ever populated. PR #305 round 9 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): rounds 7-8 still let a key with NO recorded fill evidence at all (neither a nonzero quantity nor a 部分成交/已成交 status) default to 'genuinely clear' on a later 已取消/未下单 -- but this tab has no broker synchronization, so a key once reported 已挂单 could have partially filled and been cancelled without that fill ever being disclosed; absence of a recorded fill is not proof of zero consumption. Now, once a key was ever 已挂单, its clearing 已取消/未下单 row must affirmatively state 已成交数量=0 (an explicit zero, not a blank) to count as reconciled, else 无法确认; a key never reported 已挂单 at all remains exempt, since nothing could have filled. PR #305 round 10 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): round 9's exemption was keyed on ORDER_PLACED_STATUSES={已挂单,部分成交,已成交}, which excluded 已取消 itself -- so a key whose FIRST/ONLY ever report was 已取消 with 已成交数量 blank was wrongly exempted as though the order had never been placed, when a cancellation inherently implies an order existed to cancel. Now 已取消 itself counts as order-existed evidence (scanning the whole history including the current row), so the exemption applies ONLY to a key whose entire history is 未下单 with no 已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消 at all; a later 未下单 is also no longer exempt if an earlier 已取消/已挂单/部分成交/已成交 anywhere in that key's history already proves an order once existed.
